chapters.title: Chapter 4937: Temporal Infinity III
paragraphs: Amser Modred!

Noah stared at this man that he had always known as THE Living Temporal. The purple rivers of time that surrounded the Absolute now shimmered with glimmers of blue-gold. The desperation that had filled those ancient eyes moments ago had faded, replaced by complexity that only someone who had just traded freedom for survival could possess.
There were many ways to go about things with him.
Noah could have let him be consumed. He could have watched the infection claim another Absolute and added THE Living Temporal to the growing list of beings lost to THE Primordial Mycelia.

But as he continued receiving tremendous harvest, as THE Infinite Observable Harvest and the harvest of One Fourth of a Primordial Architect flowed into his existence with force that made his foundations expand, more Infinite Everythings and Absolute Everythings formed within him.
He could afford to give one.

Frankly, THE Living Temporal was an enemy. But sometimes, one needed to do things differently. Because if he had gone ahead and not helped, THE Entity would have gained the capability to traverse and infect across time.

An infection that could reach backward into moments already passed. A rot that could claim beings before they even knew they would be claimed. A unity that could establish itself in the past and simply wait for the present to catch up.
He had effectively eliminated this possibility.
And in addition to this...
Prompts bloomed before his eyes.
|Infinite Everything Integration Complete|

|An Infinite Everything has been ingested by the subject, Amser Modred. The foreign undifferentiated authority of THE Primordial Mycelia has been burned away by the Infinite nature that now permeates his Civilization of Temporal. The infection that had been claiming his existence piece by piece has been expelled entirely. Amser Modred retains his identity, his memories, and his ambitions.|

|However, his Civilization of Temporal now exists beneath the authority of your First Tongue. This hierarchy cannot be altered through conventional means. Amser Modred’s growth will always occur under the umbrella of your Infinite authority. It always has, it always will. Temporal...has always been under your feet this whole time.|
|New Quality Acquired|

|Your Infinities have grasped the temporal weavings of Existence through Amser Modred’s bound Civilization. Your First Tongue has gained the quality of Undifferentiated Temporal Infinity. This quality allows you to interact with time in ways that were previously impossible for your Civilization.|

|At any time of your choosing, you can make the Civilization of Temporal a Derivative Civilization fully integrated into your existence. However, you already enjoy its core weavings through the subject Amser Modred, who has now been bound under THE First Tongue.|
|Applications of Undifferentiated Temporal Infinity|

|Elevation of Temporal Traversal and THE Existential Paradox Loop. Through The Interstices, set coordinates of points in time can be traversed to with more precision. Also, your ability to simulate potential outcomes has been enhanced exponentially. You can now perform Temporal Simulations of potential futures and pasts without requiring any Moirai Threads.|

|Accelerated Cultivation of Depths and Sacred Resources. You can apply Undifferentiated Temporal Infinity to the cultivation of your people’s foundations, allowing them to experience eons of training and growth within moments of Observable Existence. Beings within your Civilization can be placed in temporal environments where their Depths advance through accumulated effort that doesn’t consume time from the outside world. Additionally, you can apply this authority to the growth of Sacred Herbs in your Early Veiled Shore. Plants that would require eons to bloom can now be cultivated through temporal manipulation that doesn’t consume those eons from Observable Existence. Wonders that only bloom in the face of Infinities can be grown in controlled environments where time flows according to your will. Your dream role as a farmer has become significantly more relevant to your path of power.|

|Temporal Refuge Construction. You can create spaces where time flows differently than in Observable Existence, allowing for training and recovery that doesn’t consume time from the outside world. THE Yggdrheim could be enhanced with such properties, providing your people with unlimited time to overcome their challenges with undifferentiation.|

|Temporal Inscription Composition. When writing Inscriptions through THE First Tongue, you can now incorporate temporal elements that cause your Embodiments and Apophasis to affect targets across multiple moments simultaneously. An Inscription that would normally strike once can strike across the target’s past and present and future, causing damage that compounds through their timeline.|

|Harvest Optimization. You can apply Undifferentiated Temporal Infinity to your Infinite Observable Harvest, causing resources to flow toward you from moments that haven’t occurred yet or from moments that have already passed. This creates harvest streams that exceed what present-moment collection could provide.|
BOOM!
Noah’s existence buzzed with the implications of these prompts!

He had Infinite Undifferentiated Fate and Infinite Hunger as separate bodies entirely, currently in the process of becoming Absolutes. Their transformation was occurring even now, their foundations crossing that impossible step with ease.
And he had gained the quality of Undifferentiated Temporal Infinity!
At a time when it felt like THE Primordial Mycelia was winning on many fronts, when THE Secretive Eon had just claimed the four Strategoi of THE Agora, it was good to have this victory against it.
Preventing it from accessing time was a heavy thing!

An infection that couldn’t reach through temporal pathways was an infection that could be cornered. An infection that couldn’t establish itself in the past was an infection that could be traced to its origins. An infection that couldn’t claim the future before it arrived was an infection that could be outmaneuvered.
He had just removed one of THE Primordial Mycelia’s most dangerous potential capabilities.
He even looked at Amser Modred as he awaited his answer on exactly how he had kept the infection at bay for so long. The question wasn’t merely curiosity, though curiosity certainly played a role.
Understanding how THE Living Temporal had resisted could provide insights into fighting this thing on larger scales.

He knew part of it was the Depth of this being. Amser Modred was a powerful Absolute, one of the strongest in Observable Existence below THE Four. His foundations possessed weight that most beings couldn’t match. That weight alone would have slowed any infection.
But the other?
There had to be something else. Something about time itself that made THE Primordial Mycelia struggle to claim him completely.

Noah looked at THE Living Temporal, who gazed at him with an ancient expression filled with complexity. The purple rivers of time that surrounded him continued shimmering with blue-gold glimmers, a constant reminder of what had just changed.
Eventually, Amser Modred sighed.
He closed his eyes for a moment, and when he opened them again, the complexity had settled into something closer to tired honesty.
"Time is not merely a river that flows from past to future."
His voice emerged with weight that came from eons of intimate understanding.
"It is also a record. Every moment that occurs is inscribed into existence itself. The past doesn’t disappear. It remains, written into the foundations of reality in ways that cannot be erased."
He paused, temporal currents swirling around him with increased intensity.

"That infection... it seeks to decompose individual consciousness into unified soil. It wishes to make the many become one. But the past records who you were before the infection began. Every moment of your existence prior to contact remains inscribed in time."
His eyes met Noah’s with understanding that only someone who had just fought this battle could possess.

"I used my Temporal authority to constantly anchor myself to past moments. Moments when I was fully myself. Moments when no infection had touched my consciousness. Every time the infection tried to claim a piece of my identity, I reached into the past and pulled that piece forward again. I was essentially restoring myself from temporal backups that existed before the contamination."
He shook his head slowly.

"It wasn’t a solution. It was a delaying action. The infection was reaching further and further back, trying to claim those backup moments as well. Eventually, it would have reached the moment of my birth, and then..."
He didn’t need to finish the sentence.

"But the principle remains. The infection struggles with temporal anchoring because its methodology requires continuity of infection. If you can break that continuity by reaching to moments before the infection existed..."
His eyes blazed with purple light that now held glimmers of blue.
"You can restore what was lost. You can pull identity forward from moments when that identity was still intact. Time is the ultimate record of who we were before we became what we are now."
Noah absorbed these words with perception that was already beginning to process their implications.
Temporal anchoring!
Reaching into moments before infection.
Pulling identity forward from the past!

If beings could be connected to moments when they were uninfected, those moments could serve as templates for restoration. THE Primordial Mycelia couldn’t claim what it had never touched. And if what it had touched could be overwritten by what it hadn’t touched...
A possibility was forming in his mind.
A terrible, wonderful, incredibly complex possibility!

He would need time to develop it fully. He would need to understand more about how THE Entity operated, about its limitations, about the boundaries of its methodology. But for the first time since learning about THE Primordial Mycelia’s true nature, he felt like he was looking at a path toward genuine solution.
Noah smiled slightly as he looked at Amser Modred.
"Temporal anchoring. Restoration from moments before contamination. Using the past as a record that the infection cannot fully claim..."
His smile widened.
And the purple rivers of time surrounding THE Living Temporal shimmered with increased intensity!

chapters.title: Chapter 4938: Temporal Infinity IV
paragraphs: In THE Interstices.

Noah sat at his desk, his blue-gold pen moving with a rhythmic grace that seemed to hum alongside the fabric of existence. Beside him, Amser Modred stood in a state of quiet contemplation, his purple temporal currents now shimmering with the blue glimmers of his new allegiance.

With a casual wave of his hand, Noah manifested a second throne opposite his desk. It was a massive construct of crystallized authority, reaching nearly the same height as his own throne, though it remained just a fraction shorter...a subtle, physical reminder of the hierarchy that now bound them.
Amser stared at the discrepancy for a long moment, his eyes tracing the blue-gold veins running through the seat before he silently sat down.

Now that the immediate threat of infection was gone, the grandeur and immensity of THE Living Temporal began to return. He settled into the chair with the ease of a being who had occupied thrones for eons, the weight of his presence pressing against THE Interstices with renewed dignity.
Across from him, Noah didn’t immediately speak, his focus remaining entirely on the golden pages before him.

The scene was one of glorious, quiet power. With every stroke of the pen, infinite swirling galaxies of Absolute Seals erupted from the tip, orbiting Noah’s hand in a storm of linguistic authority. He wrote calmly, drafting Embodiments and Apophasis that crackled with the potential to reshape reality, the scratch of the pen on the golden paper being the only sound in the vast silence.
Eventually, the silence became too heavy for the newly bound Absolute to bear. Amser leaned forward, his ancient face illuminated by the radiance of Noah’s work.

"I sought you in Ginnungagap because I felt someone moving across time who may not understand the dangers involved in doing so,"Amser said, his voice holding the weight of eons of chronological stewardship.

"I sensed multiple movements. Each time, I waited for existence to unravel, for the threads of causality to fray beyond repair. But it never happened. I thought that maybe, the one involved was truly proficient enough with time to avoid disaster. But maybe it was something else entirely."
Noah didn’t stop writing. He didn’t even look up, though his hand slowed just enough to let the ink settle into a particularly complex Apophasis.
"The past is the past, and it will never change," Noah replied, his voice calm and imperious, carrying a resonance that made the gray void tremble.
"It is a self-contained causality cycle where travel to the past does not change history because the actions taken there... were ALWAYS part of that history. You and I simply did not know it."

He finally looked up, his ancient-young eyes locking onto Amser’s. "Days ago, I did not know that I would be in Ginnungagap eons before this, even though it had already happened. I simply closed that loop of time when I actually experienced it afterwards. Time flows as an unchangeable line where all events, including temporal traversal, are set in stone. My traversals across time were part of what created the timeline we remember. You never caught me during my earlier traversals when I was at my weakest... why?"
HUUM!

The sound of the pen tapping against the desk echoed like a thunderclap. Noah stopped writing, his posture straight and demanding an answer. In both of their eyes, Undifferentiated Temporal Infinity buzzed, a shared language between a master and a subordinate who both held the keys to time.
Amser Modred’s eyes flashed with a heavy, leaden solemnity. He realized then the true depth of the trap he had been in long before the infection ever touched him.
"My Temporal authority and weavings... were always under your First Tongue," Amser whispered.
"They always had been, and they were always going to be. We... just did not know it. I... did not know it. I never caught you because... I never planned on it. You... never permitted it."
BOOM!

The realization of temporal fuckery hung in the air, heavy and suffocating. Noah smiled brilliantly, a look of profound calculation crossing his features as he leaned back against his throne. The paradox was perfect; it was a masterpiece of existence even as, well...even he did not know it before now!

Amser Modred, however, looked much more affected, his foundations trembling as he grappled with the implications. "But if that is the case, why did I make that traversal across time to Ginnungagap? Why did the threads of my life pull me there if the hunt was never mine to win?"

Amser Modred’s eyes opened wide, his purple temporal light fluctuating wildly. "Who?"

Or all of this is bullshit and I am wrong, who knows."
Amser Modred found himself thinking, the wheels of eons turning in his mind. And Noah... found himself thinking too!

When there was an overabundance of crazy things happening all around existence, one had to find a shred of sanity just to make sure their state of mind remained golden. Noah was keeping himself sane while simultaneously planning, plotting, and moving across multiple fronts.

THE Primordial Mycelia had made a deadly move, taking over the four Strategoi of THE Agora of Primordial Judgment while he and Paradox were occupied with Bazuman. He had dealt a counter-blow by cutting Amser Modred from the collective and bringing him into the folds of Infinity, but the path ahead was still a razor’s edge.
He needed to breathe. And in a different corner of his existence, another body was doing exactly that.

In the Early Veiled Shore of THE Infiniverse, the air was tranquil, smelling of fresh earth and the ozone of gathering power. It was fairly empty now, as the majority of Noah’s people had been sent off to the "fun times" of THE Yggdrheim to struggle for their lives.

Noah stood in the middle of a lush field plot, his hands buried in the soil as he held golden shoots. He was filling them with radiant seas of Infinities, feeding a sacred herb the weight of an entire civilization’s potential.
He sought to make these plants experience eons of growth in moments, aiming to harvest Absolute Everythings or even Infinite Everythings from the very soil.

Behind him, the miniaturized figure of THE Mnemonic Leviathan floated serenely. In the form of a pink dolphin, the ancient entity was surrounded by a unique aura of deep, accumulated memory that made the air around it feel heavy with the weight of forgotten epochs.

"When the Youngest walks where the Oldest slumber, Existence shall tremble and the Weave shall fray. He who holds infinity in mortal palms shall stand at the crossroads where all rivers end..."Noah recited, his voice steady as he channeled power into the golden shoots.
"When Chaos speaks with the tongue of Order, when Existence questions its own being, when the Tongue falls silent and the Hunger consumes itself, then shall the Era of Undifferentiation begin...".
He paused, the golden light from the plants reflecting in his eyes as he looked back at the pink dolphin.
"You are knowledgeable in many things, Leviathan. What could any portions of these words mean to you?"
The gaze of the pink dolphin became heavy, its playful form momentarily forgotten as the weight of the prophecy settled into its consciousness. It floated in a slow, thoughtful circle.
"You...seem to be in trouble, Youngest of THE Five," the Leviathan said, its voice resonating with an ancient concern.

"You all should be in trouble. When Chaos speaks with the tongue of Order... the only way Chaos can be ordered is if it has already joined the Unity. Or Chaos is already compromised but does not know it."
WAA!
The dolphin’s eyes fixed on the golden plants.

"The Era of Undifferentiation may already be underway. This infection... THE Primordial Mycelia... it may already be far more pervasive than you all believe. If one of The Four Keys of Civilization has already fallen to it without knowing it... then undifferentiation is not coming. It is already here."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 4939: THE Youngest and THE Oldest I
paragraphs: The words from THE Mnemonic Leviathan were heavy ones.

Noah’s eyes became somber and pondering as he continued working the soil, his fingers pressing golden shoots deeper into earth that thrummed with the Infinities he was feeding into it. The coolness of the dirt beneath his nails grounded him even as his mind raced through implications.
Was this truly the case?

He had his illusory manifestation of his consciousness in the distant Primordial Realm of Alfheimr, where he was discussing things with THE Primordial Chaos. The only vibe he got from this powerful being was how cautious and careful he was when it came to THE Entity.
THE Primordial Chaos had sensed the changes in existence, and after analyzing how they unfolded, he’d kept himself away and isolated his Primordial Realm for the most part.

Even though the figures of THE Living Temporal, THE Living Dimensional, and THE Living Quantum had happened to be in Jotunheim around that same time, and all three became infected, it was only now, in the last few moments, that Noah had been able to help THE Living Temporal escape this infection.
In the weavings of all of this, could something have happened that none of them imagined?
Could Chaos truly have been compromised?
And did he simply not know it?
The possibility itself was unfathomably heavy.
He also caught another set of words that THE Mnemonic Leviathan had said. She’d referred to the aspects of the Oldest Paradox in Existence as theKeys of Civilization.
So he simply had to ask.
"Why do you call Chaos, Existence, Paradox, and THE First Tongue the Keys of Civilization?"
He already had an idea, but he had to ask anyway. This old ancient entity, with all the knowledge in Observable Existence, loved to talk even though she routinely said she only wanted to slumber.
The pink dolphin took a moment before she replied.
Her gaze drifted toward the horizon of the Early Veiled Shore, where the sky met the sea in a line of perfect, undisturbed twilight.

"They are the Keys because they are the basal, simplest fundamental definitions of the Civilizational Scale. They are the Keys that open the Doorways the Higher Scales, well, openedthe doorways to Higher Scales."
Her sonorous voice vibrated through the water and air alike.

"Many Civilization that have ever climbed the Vakochev Scales has done so by tethering itself to these four center points. They are not merely paths among many paths. They are the anchors upon which many other paths are built."
She floated in a slow circle, her pink form casting soft light across the vegetation Noah was tending.

"Chaos provides the raw, undifferentiated potential. The entropy that allows for change. Without Chaos, Civilizations would be static, unable to evolve or adapt. They would crystallize into forms that could never grow beyond their initial configurations. Chaos is the breath that keeps Civilization alive, the constant churning that prevents stagnation from claiming everything that dares to define itself."
Noah’s hands continued their work, but his attention was fully fixed on the Leviathan’s words.

"Existence provides the stability. The grounding that allows a Civilization to endure. If Chaos is the breath, then Existence is the body. It is the framework upon which all other aspects hang their authority. Without Existence, Civilizations would dissolve into the potential they drew from, unable to maintain coherence long enough to climb even a single step of the Scales. Existence declares that something IS, and that declaration is the foundation upon which everything else is built."
The dolphin’s eyes, ancient and deep despite their playful housing, turned to meet Noah’s gaze.

"Paradox allows for the impossible. The contradictions that drive evolution beyond linear growth. When a Civilization reaches the limits of what logic permits, Paradox opens doors that shouldn’t exist. It allows beings to be more than the sum of their parts, to achieve heights that their foundations alone could never support. Paradox is the exception that proves every rule, and in proving those rules, it transcends them."
She paused, her glow intensifying slightly.

"And THE First Tongue. Energy. Mana. Authority. Language...The architecture that allows a Civilization to define its own reality and write its laws into the fabric of the Existence. Where Chaos provides potential, Existence provides stability, and Paradox provides transcendence, THE First Tongue provides expression. It is the voice through which Civilizations speak themselves into being. It is the pen that writes the rules. It is the authority that declares what is permitted and what is forbidden within the boundaries of a Civilization’s domain."
Noah felt the truth of these words resonating through his own Civilization, through THE First Tongue that burned at his core with Infinite authority!
The sensation was like hearing a description of his own heartbeat from someone who had studied hearts since before hearts existed.
The Leviathan’s voice dropped to something more serious.

"These four Keys do not merely represent paths to power. They represent the fundamental architecture of the Civilizational Scale itself. The First Scale of Existence, where most beings struggle and fail and occasionally succeed, is built upon the interplay of these four Keys. Every Civilization that exists within the First Scale is, whether they know it or not, drawing from some combination of Chaos, Existence, Paradox, and THE First Tongue."
She floated closer to Noah, her ancient eyes holding depths that made even his elevated perception struggle to fully perceive.
"But THE Second Scale is different."
Noah’s hands stilled in the infinite soil as those words settled into his consciousness.
"THE Second Scale is not merely a continuation of the First. It is not simply more power, more authority, more foundation. The Second Scale...ah, its different. Even I cannot know much of it."
The dolphin’s form seemed to grow more substantial, more real, as she spoke of things that few beings in Observable Existence had ever grasped!

"But I digress. If one of these Keys is turned by an outside hand, when its fundamental nature is altered by something that shouldn’t have the authority to alter it, the very nature of what Civilization is changes. If Chaos truly speaks with the tongue of Order, if the Key of raw potential has been claimed by something that seeks to impose unity upon all things..."
She didn’t finish the sentence.
She couldn’t!

chapters.title: Chapter 4940: THE Youngest and THE Oldest II
paragraphs: Noah took in the words calmly as he thought about it all, his hands resuming their work among the vegetation he was filling with Infinities.
What was the truth, and what was false?
In existence, one could never be entirely sure of anything until they faced it.

Speculation and theory were useful tools, but they remained tools until proven or disproven through direct experience. THE Mnemonic Leviathan’s words painted a picture that was terrifying in its implications, but pictures could be inaccurate.
Perspectives could be flawed.

As for Noah right now, he had his focus on understanding the feeling of Absolute as his separated bodies in THE Agora were facing THE Primordial Mycelia, who had seemingly taken over everything there. And yet they were smiling as truly, to their nature, they didn’t offensively seek conflict.
Everything seemed despotic at the moment, but he knew these were merely the struggles of existence.
The Adversity.

Even as all of this happened, he was finding ways to combat and take care of THE Primordial Mycelia. Now, after listening to this pink dolphin beside him, it seemed like another issue might be THE Primordial Chaos.
How would he even approach this one?

THE Primordial Chaos was confident that he wasn’t affected, and as of right now, he was moving as if he had a will of his own completely. If even someone like THE Living Temporal could realize they were getting infected, someone even more ancient and powerful like THE Primordial Chaos should be the same.
But there would always be exceptions in existence.

Noah was done underestimating others. He gave an extended roadmap and leeway when it came to potential, what was possible and not possible for his enemies. He would have the mindset that THE Living Paradox could be as astounding as he wanted to be, and now THE Primordial Mycelia could be an astonishing work of existence with unfathomable potential.
Maybe it was even astounding enough to be infecting someone as grand as THE Primordial Chaos without them even knowing it. Maybe that was their long game, their biggest victory!

The thought settled into his consciousness without causing fear or despair. It was simply another factor to consider, another variable in an equation that grew more complex with every passing moment. If THE Primordial Chaos was compromised, then Noah would deal with that reality. If he wasn’t, then Noah would deal with that reality instead.
Either way, standing still and worrying accomplished nothing.
"Let’s try talking, shall we?"
Noah continued filling the plot of land with seeds packed with Infinities, his entire body emanating a sensation of peace that belied the weight of the topics just discussed.
He felt the physical sensation of the soil beneath his fingers, cool and dark and rich with the potential he was pouring into it.
The void of THE Interstices or the lush fields of the Early Veiled Shore, it didn’t matter.
Each location served its purpose. Each body he maintained accomplished tasks that his singular existence couldn’t have managed alone.
He was THE Genesis Monarch.
And he would see what the unfolding adversity of Existence would bring before his glorious Immensity!
In the Primordial Realm of Alfheimr.

In this land of vibrant life and wonder, where twilight painted everything in shades of green, white, purple and gold, Noah materialized with a unique body that he’d transferred from THE Agora to here.
It was the body holding his Infinite Undifferentiated Fate that was transforming into the Immensity of an Absolute!

He’d said it was time to talk as he thought about the issue with THE Primordial Chaos, but the one he would actually start talking with wasn’t THE Primordial Chaos at all. It was someone else entirely. Someone who might have answers that Chaos himself couldn’t provide. Someone who had existed long enough to observe patterns that younger beings couldn’t perceive.

At this moment, Noah had arrived in the skies of Alfheimr, his golden form burning with undifferentiated fate that pressed outward against the twilight atmosphere. He looked at a certain mountain in the distance.

A mountain that THE First Hunger had climbed with THE Living Origin. A mountain that THE Living Elemental had climbed with THE Living Emotive. A mountain that had at its very peak a temple shrouded in multicolored flames, holding a singular being whose existence predated most of what currently called itself alive.
THE Creature.
And the moment he arrived, oh, he saw wonder.

The mountain itself was massive, stretching toward the twilight sky with peaks that should have been visible for hundreds of miles. But even though there was a mountain here, the entire structure was actually shrouded with something that exceeded mere physical presence.

A multicolored flaming manifestation wrapped around the mountain like a second skin made of pure authority. It burned with imperious light that painted the surrounding landscape in colors that shouldn’t have existed, that made the twilight seem pale by comparison. The manifestation took the form of something vaguely humanoid, something that held the suggestion of THE Creature’s true nature without revealing its full complexity.
And its eyes.

Its pupils swirled with endless multicolored flames, ancient and patient and filled with weight that exceeded what most beings could comprehend. Those eyes seemed to be staring out across everything in this region, perceiving all that occurred within their domain.
The moment Noah saw it, he understood what this was.
Because at this moment, around his own body as well...
Golden flames erupted from his existence with force that made the twilight atmosphere ripple!

A massive manifestation of himself began forming around his body, shining with billowing golden flames of Infinite Undifferentiated Fate that pressed outward in all directions. The manifestation grew and grew, its form taking shape as an extension of his Civilization rather than merely a projection of his will.
Shockingly, it formed to be the same size and stature as the manifestation surrounding the mountain ahead!

His golden manifestation stood in the skies of Alfheimr with presence that matched THE Creature’s own, its eyes burning with the same intensity, its form radiating authority that made the very air tremble with acknowledgment!
The sensation of it was overwhelming. He could feel the manifestation as if it were his own skin, could sense everything it touched as if his nerves extended for miles in every direction.
And as it formed, Noah was able to perceive something.

For nearby light years, he could seamlessly exert his authority to enact Embodiments or Apophasis anywhere he wished in the span of an instant. The distance that had always required travel, that had always demanded conscious effort to bridge, now felt like nothing more than reaching out his hand.
This was the vision of Absolute.
This was the Immensity that they were afforded.
Prompts bloomed before his eyes.
|Absolute Depth Manifestation Detected|

|This portion of your existence is beginning to grasp the grandeur that comes with Absolute classification. |THE Absolute Effigy displays the intricacies and complexities of one’s Civilization and foundation in ways that cannot be hidden from peers. Its size is indicative of just how grand one’s Civilization is compared to others in Observable Existence.A larger Effigy represents greater foundational weight, more accumulated authority, and deeper connection to the Keys of Civilization.|
|Absolute Vision of Existence Unlocked|

|With THE Absolute Effigy comes the Absolute Vision of Existence. This allows you to perceive and exert your Immensity at vast distances instantaneously. Within the domain of your Effigy, you can enact Embodiments, speak Apophasis, and manifest your Inscriptions at speeds nothing below Absolute can match.|

|What is initially perceived by other Absolutes when observing your Effigy is a glimmer of your Civilization, the surface expression of what you have built. Anything more complex, any deeper revelation of your true nature and capabilities, is what you choose to reveal yourself. The Effigy is both armor and declaration, hiding what you wish hidden while proclaiming what you wish known.|

|Current Assessment: Your Absolute Effigy has formed at size equivalent to THE Creature’s own manifestation. Due to your foundation below Absolute being so much grander, it should frankly be much higher in height. An assessment is being done to determine other factors unaccounted for that would make your manifestation the same as THE Creature. There could potentially be a set maximum that you have simply met the conditions of.|
BOOM!
His eyes burned with golden glory!

sentences.text: Noah took in the words calmly as he thought about it all, his hands resuming their work among the vegetation he was filling with Infinities.
What was the truth, and what was false?
In existence, one could never be entirely sure of anything until they faced it.
Speculation and theory were useful tools, but they remained tools until proven or disproven through direct experience.
THE Mnemonic Leviathan’s words painted a picture that was terrifying in its implications, but pictures could be inaccurate.
Perspectives could be flawed.

As for Noah right now, he had his focus on understanding the feeling of Absolute as his separated bodies in THE Agora were facing THE Primordial Mycelia, who had seemingly taken over everything there.
And yet they were smiling as truly, to their nature, they didn’t offensively seek conflict.
Everything seemed despotic at the moment, but he knew these were merely the struggles of existence.
The Adversity.
Even as all of this happened, he was finding ways to combat and take care of THE Primordial Mycelia.
Now, after listening to this pink dolphin beside him, it seemed like another issue might be THE Primordial Chaos.
How would he even approach this one?
THE Primordial Chaos was confident that he wasn’t affected, and as of right now, he was moving as if he had a will of his own completely.
If even someone like THE Living Temporal could realize they were getting infected, someone even more ancient and powerful like THE Primordial Chaos should be the same.
But there would always be exceptions in existence.
Noah was done underestimating others.
He gave an extended roadmap and leeway when it came to potential, what was possible and not possible for his enemies.
He would have the mindset that THE Living Paradox could be as astounding as he wanted to be, and now THE Primordial Mycelia could be an astonishing work of existence with unfathomable potential.
Maybe it was even astounding enough to be infecting someone as grand as THE Primordial Chaos without them even knowing it.
Maybe that was their long game, their biggest victory!
The thought settled into his consciousness without causing fear or despair.
It was simply another factor to consider, another variable in an equation that grew more complex with every passing moment.
If THE Primordial Chaos was compromised, then Noah would deal with that reality.
If he wasn’t, then Noah would deal with that reality instead.
Either way, standing still and worrying accomplished nothing.
"Let’s try talking, shall we?"
Noah continued filling the plot of land with seeds packed with Infinities, his entire body emanating a sensation of peace that belied the weight of the topics just discussed.
He felt the physical sensation of the soil beneath his fingers, cool and dark and rich with the potential he was pouring into it.
The void of THE Interstices or the lush fields of the Early Veiled Shore, it didn’t matter.
Each location served its purpose.
Each body he maintained accomplished tasks that his singular existence couldn’t have managed alone.
He was THE Genesis Monarch.
And he would see what the unfolding adversity of Existence would bring before his glorious Immensity!
In the Primordial Realm of Alfheimr.

In this land of vibrant life and wonder, where twilight painted everything in shades of green, white, purple and gold, Noah materialized with a unique body that he’d transferred from THE Agora to here.
It was the body holding his Infinite Undifferentiated Fate that was transforming into the Immensity of an Absolute!
He’d said it was time to talk as he thought about the issue with THE Primordial Chaos, but the one he would actually start talking with wasn’t THE Primordial Chaos at all.
It was someone else entirely.
Someone who might have answers that Chaos himself couldn’t provide.
Someone who had existed long enough to observe patterns that younger beings couldn’t perceive.
At this moment, Noah had arrived in the skies of Alfheimr, his golden form burning with undifferentiated fate that pressed outward against the twilight atmosphere.
He looked at a certain mountain in the distance.
A mountain that THE First Hunger had climbed with THE Living Origin.
A mountain that THE Living Elemental had climbed with THE Living Emotive.
A mountain that had at its very peak a temple shrouded in multicolored flames, holding a singular being whose existence predated most of what currently called itself alive.
THE Creature.
And the moment he arrived, oh, he saw wonder.
The mountain itself was massive, stretching toward the twilight sky with peaks that should have been visible for hundreds of miles.
But even though there was a mountain here, the entire structure was actually shrouded with something that exceeded mere physical presence.
A multicolored flaming manifestation wrapped around the mountain like a second skin made of pure authority.
It burned with imperious light that painted the surrounding landscape in colors that shouldn’t have existed, that made the twilight seem pale by comparison.
The manifestation took the form of something vaguely humanoid, something that held the suggestion of THE Creature’s true nature without revealing its full complexity.
And its eyes.
Its pupils swirled with endless multicolored flames, ancient and patient and filled with weight that exceeded what most beings could comprehend.
Those eyes seemed to be staring out across everything in this region, perceiving all that occurred within their domain.
The moment Noah saw it, he understood what this was.
Because at this moment, around his own body as well...
Golden flames erupted from his existence with force that made the twilight atmosphere ripple!
A massive manifestation of himself began forming around his body, shining with billowing golden flames of Infinite Undifferentiated Fate that pressed outward in all directions.
The manifestation grew and grew, its form taking shape as an extension of his Civilization rather than merely a projection of his will.
Shockingly, it formed to be the same size and stature as the manifestation surrounding the mountain ahead!

His golden manifestation stood in the skies of Alfheimr with presence that matched THE Creature’s own, its eyes burning with the same intensity, its form radiating authority that made the very air tremble with acknowledgment!
The sensation of it was overwhelming.
He could feel the manifestation as if it were his own skin, could sense everything it touched as if his nerves extended for miles in every direction.
And as it formed, Noah was able to perceive something.
For nearby light years, he could seamlessly exert his authority to enact Embodiments or Apophasis anywhere he wished in the span of an instant.
The distance that had always required travel, that had always demanded conscious effort to bridge, now felt like nothing more than reaching out his hand.
This was the vision of Absolute.
This was the Immensity that they were afforded.

chapters.title: Chapter 4941: THE Youngest and THE Oldest III
paragraphs: At this time, his Absolute Effigy stared straight ahead at the mountain as he was looking into the eyes of THE Creature!

The multicolored flames that comprised that ancient being’s manifestation met his golden gaze with weight that spoke of eons of accumulated existence, of patience that transcended mortal understanding, of power that had shaped Observable Existence since before most beings knew what existence meant.
Noah had said how he didn’t want to climb up a mountain to talk to this being.
It seemed that the statement would remain true.

His Absolute Effigy was grand enough that he could see this unfathomable entity right in front of him, could meet its gaze as an equal rather than a supplicant climbing toward an audience. The distance between them meant nothing now!

The elevation meant nothing. The physical barrier of the mountain itself meant nothing when two Absolute Effigies could simply turn their attention toward each other and communicate across miles as easily as speaking across a room.
It was a unique thing for Noah as he felt like he had truly come far.

The vision was encompassing everything around him, his Absolute Effigy being an extension of his body rather than something separate from it. He could feel the weight of the twilight pressing against his golden flames. He could sense the pulse of life throughout Alfheimr responding to the presence of two Absolute Effigies dominating its skies. He could perceive details that his previous existence would have required concentrated effort to observe.
At this time, THE Youngest looked ahead as his gaze connected with THE Oldest.

But even this might be something up for debate. Because any day that one had an argument with THE Primordial Chaos, he would say that he was THE Oldest. That his existence predated even THE Creature’s ancient form. That his authority over Chaos itself spoke of primordial origins that exceeded what others could claim.
What argument could be had would be for later.

These two beings looked at each other fully for the first time, without any interruptions or complications. No battles occurring in their periphery. No Undivided Ones emerging from Cracks. No infections spreading through Strategoi while they were distracted. Just the two of them, Absolute Effigy facing Absolute Effigy, across the twilight skies of Alfheimr.

The gaze of the multicolored Absolute Effigy of THE Creature held natural and innate majesty. Regality that seemed woven into its very existence, as if one was staring at a noble entity whose bloodline stretched back to the First Cause itself. Those swirling multicolored pupils observed Noah with patience that spoke of someone who had watched countless beings rise and fall across eons, who had seen potential bloom and wither more times than could be counted.

The golden Absolute Effigy of Noah held endless quintessence and Infinity. His eyes surged with billowing golden Undifferentiated Fate that could make an existence see endless variations and possibilities reflected in their depths. Where THE Creature’s gaze spoke of ancient observation, Noah’s gaze spoke of infinite potential. Where the multicolored flames declared what had been, the golden flames declared what could be.
At this moment, Noah felt like he’d already taken the first step by appearing here.
He didn’t say anything.
He only looked at THE Creature.

The billowing multicolored face of THE Creature’s Absolute Effigy changed subtly at this moment, blooming with quite a bit more liveliness. It was as if this ancient being was fully breaking his weavings here, allowing more expression to flow through his manifestation than he typically permitted. His eyes blinked with motion that seemed almost playful despite the weight they carried. The massive head of his Absolute Effigy moved freely, tilting slightly as he observed Noah with interest.
Then this being said calmly, his voice resonating through the domain where their Effigies overlapped.
"You seem... to have arrived at Absolute. Congratulations. That should be the fastest in Observable Existence."
The first words that THE Creature said toward Noah were uniquely words of congratulations.

Not challenge or threat. Not posturing. Just simple acknowledgment of an achievement that deserved recognition, delivered with warmth that seemed genuine despite the Existential weight behind every syllable.
Noah took in these words calmly as he gave a light nod.
"Thank you."
As if to confirm and ascertain that yes, that was him. That was what he’d done. And only he had that achievement and accomplishment!

The fastest being in Observable Existence to achieve Absolute Depth, arriving at heights that most beings couldn’t reach across eons of dedicated cultivation in what amounted to moments by comparison.
After he said this, he seemed to have realized something.

He looked down, his golden gaze piercing the landscape of the mountain that held the temple of THE Creature at its very peak. His Absolute Vision of Existence allowed him to perceive details that his previous sight would have required focused attention to observe, and what he saw made his expression shift with something between amusement and contempt.
On this mountain, he’d almost dismissed them.
But there were the Absolute Effigies of THE Living Elemental and THE Living Emotive.
They were just too fucking small.

THE Living Emotive’s Absolute Effigy was formed of swirling pink and crimson light that pulsed with manic energy matching her emotional nature. It wrapped around her position on the mountain with presence that spoke of genuine power, of authority that had been accumulated across eons of Absolute existence.
But it was only a fraction of the size compared to Noah and THE Creature.
Barely a fourth their stature.

Her Effigy, which would have seemed grand when compared to most beings in Observable Existence, looked almost modest when placed beside the towering manifestations that dominated the skies. She was powerful, yes. An Absolute of genuine capability. But the gap between her accumulated authority and theirs was visible in the simple comparison of scale.
And THE Living Elemental...
That pathetic, curse-writhing heap of deteriorating foundations had an Absolute Effigy that was barely a hundredth their size!
It was so fucking pitiful to look at.

The small flickering flames that comprised his manifestation were sickly and unstable, constantly wavering as if they might extinguish at any moment. The curse that Noah had placed upon him was visible even here, burning through his Effigy with lines of blue-gold authority that declared his foundations no longer entirely his own. His presence on the mountain was almost an embarrassment, like a candle flame trying to assert itself beside two suns.
Meanwhile, on the side of the mountain, there was also the Absolute Effigy of THE Undivided One that THE Living Emotive had bonded herself to.

The winged lion’s manifestation burned with light of undifferentiation that spoke of its origins in THE Prima Indifferentia. Its serpent mane was visible even in its Effigy form, countless heads swaying with motion that seemed hypnotic. Its size was around the same as Emotive’s, a fourth of what Noah and THE Creature displayed, speaking of power that was substantial but not supreme.
The Effigy of Emotive was looking toward Noah right now.

Her pink eyes shone with brilliant interest and fascination that seemed to overflow from her manifestation like heat from a forge. There was hunger in that gaze, but not the consumption kind. It was the hunger of someone who had found something fascinating, something she wanted to examine more closely, something she wanted to claim in ways that her manic nature demanded.
It was as if she wanted to jump on him right here and now.
And the Absolute Effigy of THE Living Elemental was looking toward Noah as well.
But his expression was entirely different!

chapters.title: Chapter 4942: THE Youngest and THE Oldest IV
paragraphs: Shock and horror twisted his sickly features into something even more pathetic than his usual state. His eyes were wide with disbelief that bordered on denial. His mouth hung open as if he wanted to speak but couldn’t find words that would adequately express the devastation of what he was witnessing.
He’d never expected Noah to be as massive as THE Creature.

He’d known that THE Youngest was growing. He’d felt the curse burning through his foundations. He’d understood on some level that the being who had cursed him was becoming something dangerous. But this? Standing equal to size of THE Creature himself? Having an Absolute Effigy that matched the most ancient being in Observable Existence in size and presence?
This exceeded anything his deteriorating mind had prepared for.
When Noah looked down at these Absolute Effigies, his own manifestation moved.

His golden hand reached downward with motion that seemed casual despite the Existential implications. His fingers formed a pinching gesture, as if he was about to pick up something small and insignificant from a table.
And right after, the body of THE Living Elemental began to fly off the mountain!

The pitiful Absolute was pulled upward by authority that exceeded anything his weakened existence could resist. His Effigy flickered and wavered as Noah’s golden fingers pinched around it, dragging him through the air toward the manifestation that had claimed him. His face twisted with defiance that he couldn’t back with actual power, and horror that he couldn’t hide despite his attempts at dignity.
He floated upward, pulled by THE Youngest like a toy being retrieved by a child who had grown tired of letting it rest.
Noah held that pathetic, curse-ridden disgrace of an Absolute before his golden gaze with expression that held no mercy and no hesitation.
He grasped both the Absolute Effigy and body of THE Living Elemental in his hands!

This absolute waste of space. This pathetic embarrassment of an Absolute who had dared to stand against him. The sensation of holding this being’s existence was almost unpleasant, like gripping something rotten that was falling apart in his fingers. The golden flames of his Effigy pressed against the sickly flickering light of Elemental’s manifestation with dominance that couldn’t be questioned.
He didn’t even want this wretch to be a stain that wasted any time from this moment.

But before Noah could act, THE Living Elemental turned his deteriorating Effigy toward THE Creature and Emotive. His eyes were wild with desperation that exceeded anything Noah had seen from him before. His voice emerged with pleading that stripped away whatever dignity he might have once possessed.
"I gave my Everything! Please, I was among you! In the Legends, in our stories, in the Earliest Folds!"
His words tumbled out with speed that spoke of panic consuming rational thought.
"Just help me against this being-"
HUUM!
Before his words could ever finish, Noah pinched his fingers.
And this dumb fucker disappeared.

The sensation was satisfying in ways that Noah hadn’t anticipated. One moment, that pitiful excuse for an Absolute was begging for salvation from beings who clearly had no intention of providing it. The next moment, his existence was simply gone from Alfheimr entirely, pulled into a place where his suffering could continue without polluting Noah’s immediate surroundings.
Prompts bloomed before his eyes.
|Forced Imprisonment Executed|

|THE Living Elemental, that decrepit flaming ballsack of deteriorating foundations, has been forcefully placed into THE Infinite Desmoterion within your Organ of Civilization. He did not go willingly. He did not go with dignity. He went screaming into confinement that will last until you decide otherwise.|

|Within THE Infinite Desmoterion, infinite dilated time will ensure that his imprisonment feels like eons regardless of how much time passes in Observable Existence. He will be welcomed and disciplined by Ozymandias, who has expressed particular interest in breaking this pathetic creature’s remaining pride. Eventually, THE Living Elemental may progress in his Civilization, but any progress he makes will occur under your banner of existence. Anything he does will only further elevate you until you choose to put this dog out of its misery.|
|This was a fitting end for a being who dared to challenge THE Genesis Monarch. Let him rot in infinite time until you decide he has suffered enough. Or let him rot forever. The choice is yours.|
The prompts were cathartic to see.

Noah felt satisfaction spreading through his chest as the words settled into his consciousness. That wretched creature would spend what felt like eternities being broken down and rebuilt under the watchful gaze of Ozymandias. Every improvement he made would flow upward to Noah. Every fragment of his Civilization that recovered would strengthen the very being who had conquered him.
It was justice of the most complete kind.
After this was done, Noah got back to looking at THE Creature.

This entity didn’t say anything regarding his recent actions. His multicolored Absolute Effigy continued observing with the same patient expression it had held before, those swirling pupils tracking Noah’s movements without judgment or commentary. It was as if the disposal of THE Living Elemental was of no consequence whatsoever.
Noah didn’t mention anything about it either.
Why would he? It was simply taking out worthless garbage that had been cluttering the conversation space.
In the next moment, vibrant multicolored brilliance shone all around them!

The light expanded outward from THE Creature’s Absolute Effigy with force that pressed against Noah’s perception. Everything nearby began to fade as this brilliance consumed it. The mountain disappeared. The temple at its peak disappeared. The Absolute Effigies of Emotive and her bonded Undivided One disappeared. The twilight sky of Alfheimr disappeared.
Everything vanished into oblivion.

The only ones remaining were the Absolute Effigies of Noah and THE Creature, sitting inside an empty multicolored stellar space that stretched in all directions. Stars of every color burned in the distance, but they felt more like decoration than actual celestial bodies. The space itself hummed with authority that spoke of THE Creature’s absolute dominion over this environment.
It was as if they were no longer in the Primordial Realm of Alfheimr at all.
THE Creature’s voice emerged with calmness that made the stellar space vibrate gently around them.
"I hope you don’t mind."

His multicolored Effigy shifted slightly, settling into a posture that seemed almost conversational despite its scale. Within the Effigy, Noah could perceive the actual body of THE Creature, and both held an extraordinary air of power and nobleness that seemed woven into their very existence.
Every movement he made carried weight that spoke of eons of accumulated authority. Every word emerged with precision that suggested careful consideration despite its casual delivery.
"I did not want random interruptions here and there, and I have been very curious about you."
Those swirling multicolored eyes fixed on Noah’s golden gaze.
"I have tried to meet you eons in the past, but things never seemed to align. You became a friend of my friend, Anaximander, but even that was not enough for us to meet."
He paused, something like acceptance crossing his noble features.
"Alas, things are how they should be."
Noah gave a light nod to THE Creature as he processed these words.
He proceeded to respond with honesty that matched the directness THE Creature had shown.
"I only ever heard legends about you from Fold Dwellers and Living Existences. Stories of the Earliest Folds."
His golden Effigy burned with increased intensity as he spoke, the flames of Undifferentiated Fate swirling with patterns that reflected his contemplation.
"Every time I listened to them, I envisioned these grand legends and beings that seemed so distant and far off. That seemed like they were a different grouping of existences entirely."
His eyes met THE Creature’s swirling gaze directly.
"Amongst all the stories I heard, I was always curious about THE Creature. I had many questions back then."
He paused.
"But I only have one question now that may matter more than anything else."
The stellar space around them seemed to grow more still, as if existence itself was waiting for what would be asked.
"Are you there? Are you at THE Second Scale of Existence?"

His Effigy flickered and wavered as Noah’s golden fingers pinched around it, dragging him through the air toward the manifestation that had claimed him.
His face twisted with defiance that he couldn’t back with actual power, and horror that he couldn’t hide despite his attempts at dignity.
He floated upward, pulled by THE Youngest like a toy being retrieved by a child who had grown tired of letting it rest.
Noah held that pathetic, curse-ridden disgrace of an Absolute before his golden gaze with expression that held no mercy and no hesitation.
He grasped both the Absolute Effigy and body of THE Living Elemental in his hands!
This absolute waste of space.
This pathetic embarrassment of an Absolute who had dared to stand against him.
The sensation of holding this being’s existence was almost unpleasant, like gripping something rotten that was falling apart in his fingers.
The golden flames of his Effigy pressed against the sickly flickering light of Elemental’s manifestation with dominance that couldn’t be questioned.
He didn’t even want this wretch to be a stain that wasted any time from this moment.
But before Noah could act, THE Living Elemental turned his deteriorating Effigy toward THE Creature and Emotive.
His eyes were wild with desperation that exceeded anything Noah had seen from him before.
His voice emerged with pleading that stripped away whatever dignity he might have once possessed.
"I gave my Everything!
Please, I was among you!
In the Legends, in our stories, in the Earliest Folds!"
His words tumbled out with speed that spoke of panic consuming rational thought.
"Just help me against this being-"
HUUM!
Before his words could ever finish, Noah pinched his fingers.
And this dumb fucker disappeared.
The sensation was satisfying in ways that Noah hadn’t anticipated.
One moment, that pitiful excuse for an Absolute was begging for salvation from beings who clearly had no intention of providing it.
The next moment, his existence was simply gone from Alfheimr entirely, pulled into a place where his suffering could continue without polluting Noah’s immediate surroundings.
Prompts bloomed before his eyes.
|Forced Imprisonment Executed|
|THE Living Elemental, that decrepit flaming ballsack of deteriorating foundations, has been forcefully placed into THE Infinite Desmoterion within your Organ of Civilization.
He did not go willingly.
He did not go with dignity.
He went screaming into confinement that will last until you decide otherwise.|
|Within THE Infinite Desmoterion, infinite dilated time will ensure that his imprisonment feels like eons regardless of how much time passes in Observable Existence.
He will be welcomed and disciplined by Ozymandias, who has expressed particular interest in breaking this pathetic creature’s remaining pride.
Eventually, THE Living Elemental may progress in his Civilization, but any progress he makes will occur under your banner of existence.
Anything he does will only further elevate you until you choose to put this dog out of its misery.|
|This was a fitting end for a being who dared to challenge THE Genesis Monarch.
Let him rot in infinite time until you decide he has suffered enough.
Or let him rot forever.
The choice is yours.|
The prompts were cathartic to see.
Noah felt satisfaction spreading through his chest as the words settled into his consciousness.
That wretched creature would spend what felt like eternities being broken down and rebuilt under the watchful gaze of Ozymandias.
Every improvement he made would flow upward to Noah.
Every fragment of his Civilization that recovered would strengthen the very being who had conquered him.
It was justice of the most complete kind.
After this was done, Noah got back to looking at THE Creature.
This entity didn’t say anything regarding his recent actions.
His multicolored Absolute Effigy continued observing with the same patient expression it had held before, those swirling pupils tracking Noah’s movements without judgment or commentary.
It was as if the disposal of THE Living Elemental was of no consequence whatsoever.
Noah didn’t mention anything about it either.
Why would he?
It was simply taking out worthless garbage that had been cluttering the conversation space.
In the next moment, vibrant multicolored brilliance shone all around them!
The light expanded outward from THE Creature’s Absolute Effigy with force that pressed against Noah’s perception.
Everything nearby began to fade as this brilliance consumed it.
The mountain disappeared.
The temple at its peak disappeared.
The Absolute Effigies of Emotive and her bonded Undivided One disappeared.
The twilight sky of Alfheimr disappeared.
Everything vanished into oblivion.
The only ones remaining were the Absolute Effigies of Noah and THE Creature, sitting inside an empty multicolored stellar space that stretched in all directions.
Stars of every color burned in the distance, but they felt more like decoration than actual celestial bodies.
The space itself hummed with authority that spoke of THE Creature’s absolute dominion over this environment.
It was as if they were no longer in the Primordial Realm of Alfheimr at all.
THE Creature’s voice emerged with calmness that made the stellar space vibrate gently around them.
"I hope you don’t mind."
His multicolored Effigy shifted slightly, settling into a posture that seemed almost conversational despite its scale.
Within the Effigy, Noah could perceive the actual body of THE Creature, and both held an extraordinary air of power and nobleness that seemed woven into their very existence.
Every movement he made carried weight that spoke of eons of accumulated authority.
Every word emerged with precision that suggested careful consideration despite its casual delivery.
"I did not want random interruptions here and there, and I have been very curious about you."
Those swirling multicolored eyes fixed on Noah’s golden gaze.
"I have tried to meet you eons in the past, but things never seemed to align.
You became a friend of my friend, Anaximander, but even that was not enough for us to meet."
He paused, something like acceptance crossing his noble features.
"Alas, things are how they should be."
Noah gave a light nod to THE Creature as he processed these words.
He proceeded to respond with honesty that matched the directness THE Creature had shown.
"I only ever heard legends about you from Fold Dwellers and Living Existences.
Stories of the Earliest Folds."
His golden Effigy burned with increased intensity as he spoke, the flames of Undifferentiated Fate swirling with patterns that reflected his contemplation.
"Every time I listened to them, I envisioned these grand legends and beings that seemed so distant and far off.
That seemed like they were a different grouping of existences entirely."
His eyes met THE Creature’s swirling gaze directly.
"Amongst all the stories I heard, I was always curious about THE Creature.
I had many questions back then."
He paused.
"But I only have one question now that may matter more than anything else."
The stellar space around them seemed to grow more still, as if existence itself was waiting for what would be asked.
"Are you there?
Are you at THE Second Scale of Existence?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4943: THE Youngest and THE Oldest V
paragraphs: Noah asked this as he truly couldn’t tell.
And it was because he couldn’t tell that he felt this being might just be there already.
If anyone had achieved such wonder, it would be THE Creature.
But Noah needed confirmation, not simply theory.

Before him, THE Creature remained calm and without expressing too much emotion. His multicolored Effigy held steady, those swirling pupils continuing their eternal rotation without acceleration or deceleration. He seemed thoughtful for a moment, considering the question with weight that spoke of how seriously he took it despite his casual demeanor.
Then he spoke.
"Yes and no."
BOOM!
The words hung in the stellar space between them.
"I cannot say much about it. Because... it will spoil the surprise."
His noble features shifted into something that might have been gentle amusement.

"You will actually thank me for not saying too much on it. Some things deserve to be experienced in their entirety. And beings like you and I are only at the beginning stages of our journey. We should not spoil each other’s starting points."
His voice dropped to something more serious.
"It deserves to be experienced. The Scales deserve to be experienced without being spoiled. Even though it may be cryptic, I actually cannot say whether I am...or whether I am not."
He paused, and when he continued, his words carried weight that exceeded their apparent simplicity.
"Existence is too vast. And I have only just grasped a foothold of it."
The multicolored flames of his Effigy burned brighter.
"Some Primordial Architects were born at this foothold. They are those blessed in existence, and also the most cursed in existence."
His eyes fixed on Noah with intensity that pressed against the golden flames.

"And I... I was simply someone who wanted to change my fate. Someone who wanted to change my existence. My choices and my weavings ultimately led to where I am today. Just like your choices and your weavings led you to where you are right now."
His voice held finality that couldn’t be argued with.
"It would be a tremendous disservice for me if I were to spoil where you were headed. When you get here, I hope to be there to congratulate you just as I congratulated you for achieving Absolute."
BOOM!
THE Creature made a few things clear.

One was the distinction between them. Even if he didn’t say it clearly, from his words it seemed abundantly apparent that Noah was at one point, and THE Creature was at a distant other point. The gap hadn’t been explicitly defined, but its existence was undeniable. THE Creature spoke of being somewhere that Noah would eventually arrive, spoke of hoping to congratulate him when that arrival occurred!
There was a destination. And Noah wasn’t there yet.

He also said that he moved to change his fate. To change his existence. And he chose to say this right after mentioning the Primordial Architects who were both blessed and cursed across existence. Was THE Creature connected to these beings? Or was he such a being who had altered his weavings of existence to become what he was right now?
Noah couldn’t say for sure.

He’d actually come here with many questions. About THE Living Paradox and his spreading corruption. About THE Primordial Mycelia and its infection of the Strategoi. About THE Primordial Chaos and whether he might be compromised without knowing it. About prophecies and their implications. About everything that was occurring across Observable Existence.
But as he was here right now, it didn’t seem like all these many questions mattered.
Because asking about any of it was essentially asking for help from THE Creature.
And he...
"I... do not need any help."
BOOM!
Noah found himself saying these words as if he’d come under some form of realization and epiphany!

The golden flames of his Absolute Effigy burned brighter as the truth of the statement settled into his foundations. He’d come here thinking he needed guidance and answers. Thinking he needed assistance from someone more experienced, more powerful, more established in the heights of existence. But standing here now, facing THE Creature as an equal in manifestation if not in achievement, he understood something fundamental.
The adversity was his.
The challenges were his.
The path forward was his to walk, not to be carried along by another!
If he sought help...he would actually be halting his own foundations!
When he arrived at this point, for the first time, THE Creature smiled lightly.
The expression transformed his noble features into something warmer. His multicolored eyes burned.
"Adversity is a rare thing for people like us."
His voice resonated through the stellar space with depth that pressed against Noah’s perception.
"To have so much of it, I am slightly jealous of you. Because I had to do a lot to bombard myself with adversity to get me where I currently am."
He paused, and when he continued, his words held weight that came from eons of accumulated experience.
"Sometimes it will feel unbearable. Sometimes you may feel loss. Sometimes those you made promises to... can look at you and tell you how you let them down."
His swirling eyes held understanding.
Was he talking about Origin? THE Dead Order? Law?
"The suffering. The ups and downs. All of these are part of existence. I am sure that soon enough, our difficulties might align. But until then, you have your difficulties, and I have mine."
His smile grew slightly wider.
"Out of all of this adversity is only endless brilliance."
He leaned forward, his Effigy shifting with the motion as his words took on intensity that pressed against the stellar space itself.

"Do you know... every single Absolute out there, every entity that may believe that they are standing at the very peak of the First Scale of Existence... none are using even one percent of what their very existence is capable of?"
BOOM!
The words struck Noah with force that made his golden flames tremble!
"Not even a single percentage."
THE Creature’s voice dropped to something almost conspiratorial.
"When you get close to THE Second Scale, when you start to understand, truly understand... only then will you realize the immensity of what lies in existence."
His multicolored eyes burned with fire that seemed to contain entire Folds.
"And how we have only been fumbling in the darkness for eons."

chapters.title: Chapter 4944: Countable, Uncountable, Absolute! I
paragraphs: Existence was vast, and they had been stumbling in the darkness for eons.

The words were heavy ones as Noah took some time to think about all of them. His golden Absolute Effigy burned steadily in the multicolored stellar space that THE Creature had created around them, the flames of Undifferentiated Fate pulsing with rhythms that matched his contemplation.
Especially the words about how all existences were barely using even one percent of what their very existence was capable of.
One percent of what exactly?
He looked up at the Absolute Effigy of THE Creature, about to ask this question when he saw the calm and noble air of this being.
Noah knew even if he asked, THE Creature would talk about how he didn’t want to do the disservice of spoiling things.

But his words did allow for contemplation even if Noah asked him for no help on anything. His adversity was his, and THE Creature’s adversity was his own. They walked separate paths that might converge eventually, but for now, they remained distinct.
So instead, he asked something else.
"How was your Foundation at the level of Absolute?"
Foundation!

He was curious about this. The concept had been circling in his mind since he’d achieved Absolute with his separated bodies, since he’d felt the difference between his foundations and what others might possess at similar Depths. After he asked, THE Creature had a pondering look.
Then he spoke with weight that pressed against the stellar space around them.
"Foundation at the First Scale of Existence is everything. It is not merely a measurement of current power. It is the breadth of what your power can become when you step beyond."
His noble features held something that might have been regret.

"Imagine two beings who both achieve THE Second Scale. Both have crossed that threshold. Both stand at heights that most existences cannot comprehend. And yet, depending on whether one had an astounding Foundation before that crossing, the difference between them becomes..."
He paused, searching for words adequate to the concept.

"One could look at the other on that same Scale, peer at them from equivalent classification, and yet break them with a flick of their thumb. The Foundation built before advancement determines the vastness of what that advancement produces. It is the seed from which the tree grows. A larger seed produces a larger tree, even when both trees receive identical sunlight."
His multicolored eyes fixed on Noah with intensity.
"Foundation is that pivotal before you can proceed ahead. It is not merely important. It is the determining factor of everything that comes after."
THE Creature’s flames dimmed slightly.

"Mine was merely sufficient. But I am still not happy with it. Because of that, I am doing some things to rectify it. Even now, even at the heights I have reached, I work to improve what I built before those heights were achieved. The Foundation never stops mattering. Never."
His was merely sufficient!

THE Creature, this ancient being whose Absolute Effigy matched Noah’s own in size, whose existence had shaped Observable Existence since before most beings knew what existence meant, considered his Foundation merely sufficient?
There were countless paths that one could take in existence. Countless ways to measure progress and achievement. Countless methodologies for understanding where one stood in relation to others.

At this moment, Noah was about to gaze at THE Creature to get a gauge on his comparative Depth at the level of Absolute. He had done this for Surface, Intermediate, and Fundamental Depths. He had measured himself against THE Primordial Paradox, against the baselines that Observable Existence provided, against frameworks that allowed him to understand his position relative to others.

He was about to now get a gauge of THE Creature, to also see how different it was between him and THE Primordial Paradox, to understand truly where he stood among the greatest beings in Observable Existence.
But for some odd reason, he felt his existence resisting this.
As if his Infinite Formless Depth inherently didn’t want to do this.

Noah paused momentarily, his golden flames flickering with uncertainty that lasted only a fraction of a second. Then he listened to this thought. Because he always listened to his intuition. It had guided him through dangers that logic couldn’t navigate. It had warned him of threats that conscious analysis missed. It had led him to opportunities that deliberate searching never found.
And the moment he began thinking more and more about this resistance, his eyes began to brighten up!
As if he had been undergoing yet another epiphany!

Other people could have a hard time grasping the allure of profundities and epiphanies. They struggled for eons to achieve single moments of clarity. They fought against their own limitations just to glimpse understanding that exceeded their current state.
And yet, for Noah, it seemed that whenever he was in a unique state of mind, they continued to come and come endlessly.
Almost as if there was the allure of Infinity that bloomed countless possibilities inside of him.
Almost as if!
But for his epiphany, the realization that was crystallizing in his consciousness with weight that exceeded mere thought...

He had long established that his Infinite Formless Depth was far different from anyone else. He knew comparisons were only there as a point of reference for him to gauge how much grander he was compared to others.
How much grander he was.

His own ego. His own mentality. That good feeling that he felt every time he saw the number in front of his Foundation say ten times more than this legendary being, or twenty times more immense of a Foundation than that legendary being.
The sense of accomplishment while knowing this was nice!
But...
He decided at this time that there would be no more point of comparison for Surface or Intermediate or Fundamental!
And he wouldn’t seek to grasp the potential knowledge of the difference of Immensity between his Absolute Depth and THE Creature’s.

The comparisons were unique and great tools, yes. They had served him well in understanding his progress. They had provided motivation when progress seemed slow. They had given him targets to surpass and benchmarks to exceed.
But in here, with adversity building up, at this moment, Noah decided that he was going against himself and only the limits that he set forth!
