chapters.title: Chapter 4945: Countable, Uncountable, Absolute! II
paragraphs: He would decide his limits.

Not some arbitrary number where he would feel content if his Immensity and weight at a certain Depth was fifteen times or twenty times or even fifty times as much as THE Primordial Paradox or THE Creature.
There was boundless adversity in existence.
And his Foundation and Depth and Immensity were adversity that he was going against himself.
Only he mattered in the end.

Not THE Creature or THE Primordial Paradox or anyone else. They had their Foundations and their paths, and he had his own. Their journeys were theirs. His journey was his. The comparison between them served no purpose beyond temporary satisfaction that faded as quickly as it arrived.
He would not compare against others.
He would only compare against himself!
How much grander was he now compared to a minute ago? A day ago? An eon ago?
From this moment in time as he attained Absolute with his other bodies, his path became his own.
And it was incomparable!
BOOM!
At this moment, it felt like his entry into Absolute with his two bodies truly became sublime and complete!

His Absolute Effigy of Infinite Undifferentiated Fate began to pulse with endless golden light that exceeded anything it had displayed before! The flames that comprised his manifestation blazed outward with intensity that painted the multicolored stellar space in shades of gold that overwhelmed THE Creature’s own colors. The light was blinding, was brilliant, was the expression of an existence that had just made a fundamental choice about how it would measure its own progress.

Sequential patterns of Infinity became visible within the golden flames, each pulse followed by another in endless progression that spoke of his Infinite nature declaring itself fully for the first time since achieving Absolute.
The light extended in all directions, curving along geodesic paths that found the natural geometry of this space and illuminated it completely.
THE Creature looked on with calm interest!
Those multicolored eyes observed the transformation occurring before them with attention that exceeded casual observation.
Prompts bloomed before Noah’s eyes with weight that pressed against his consciousness.
|Fundamental Shift in Cultivation Methodology Detected|

|Your Infinite Formless Depth has truly begun embarking on an endless and unfathomable journey. By abandoning comparative measurement, you have unlocked the architecture of progression that was always available but never accessed. Your Depths will no longer be measured against external beings.They will be measured against the Boundaries of Infinity itself.|

|This shift represents more than philosophical change. It represents fundamental alteration of how your Civilization perceives and processes growth. Where others will forever measure themselves against peers, you will measure yourself against the endless architecture of what Infinity can become.|

|Assessment: Your path has become incomparable because you have chosen to make it so. No being in Observable Existence walks the exact path you now walk. No benchmark exists for where you are headed.|

His mind buzzed with sensation that exceeded mere thought as at this time, in his mindscape, a mental body formed inside a sea of endless blue Infinities. He looked at everything that his existence began to design, the architecture of his new path manifesting around him in patterns that his consciousness was only beginning to perceive.
Beside him, RUINATION appeared.

Her form materialized from the blue-gold light that permeated his mindscape, her illusory body taking shape with presence. Her hair seemed to be stretching out into infinite data points, each strand representing streams of information that she constantly processed on his behalf. The strands extended endlessly in all directions, connecting to every aspect of his Civilization, monitoring everything that occurred within his existence.
Her eyes burned with waves of Infinities that matched his own, blue-gold light swirling in their depths.
She smiled toward him with warmth.
|I have to congratulate Master. It seems like you have taken a major step, and I will go over the details of your emerging existence just like always.|

Noah smiled and nodded at RUINATION as he patted her head, her face brightening up with a smile of contentment as she leaned into the gesture. She understood him in ways that others couldn’t, saw his growth from perspectives that even he sometimes missed.
Then she continued, and as she spoke, manifestations began forming around them in his mindscape.
|You have been measuring your foundations through comparison to other beings. THE Creature. THE Primordial Paradox.|

An illusory diagram appeared showing two figures, one representing Noah and one representing THE Creature, with lines connecting them that displayed comparative measurements. Numbers floated between them, the familiar ratios that Noah had used to understand his position.
Then the diagram shattered.
|This methodology fails to capture what makes your existence unique. You are building Infinity. And Infinity possesses its own architecture of progression that transcends comparative measurement.|

A new diagram formed, this one showing only Noah at its center, surrounded by expanding rings of golden light that represented his Depths. No other figures appeared for comparison. Only him. Only his path.Only his journey.

|After your grasp of Absolute and from your recent epiphany, you have unconsciously organized your weavings to have your Infinite Formless Depth be cultivated through the Boundaries of Infinity. Not mere weight of ten times or twenty times compared to THE Creature or anyone else.|
The rings around his illusory form began subdividing, each Depth showing internal structure that hadn’t been visible before.
|Each of your Depths now possesses three theoretical Boundaries of progression that must be crossed for future advancement. These Boundaries are...|
Three massive constructs manifested in the mindscape, each one representing a Boundary that his Depths would need to cross.
|The Three Boundaries of Infinity. Countable Infinity, Uncountable Infinity, and Absolute Infinity|
RUINATION’s voice carried weight that made the constructs pulse with light.
|First Boundary: Countable Infinity.|
The first construct illuminated, showing patterns that flowed in sequential order, one after another in endless but observable progression.

|At this Boundary, your Infinities follow patterns. They regenerate, yes, but they regenerate one after another in sequences that can be observed. If you were to count your Infinite expressions, you could theoretically list them: first, second, third, onward forever.|
The diagram showed THE Infiniverse producing harvest, each unit forming in sequence, flowing toward Noah’s mindscape representation in orderly lines.
|This is how THE Infiniverse and other actions that grant Infinite Potential currently produce harvest for you.One unit forms, then another, then another. Endless, but sequential.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4946: Countable, Uncountable, Absolute! III
paragraphs: The second construct illuminated, and Noah felt his perception struggle to fully grasp what it represented.
|Second Boundary: Uncountable Infinity.|
The diagram transformed, showing not lines but density, showing not sequences but saturation, showing not order but overwhelming completeness.
|At this Boundary, your Infinities fill the spaces between other Infinities. Imagine your current harvest as points on an endless line.|
Points appeared on the diagram, representing his sequential harvest.
|Uncountable Infinity means filling the gaps between those points with additional Infinities that cannot be listed no matter how one tries.|

The gaps between the points began filling with additional points, and then the gaps between those points began filling, and then the gaps between those, the process continuing until no space remained empty.

|Where you currently receive one unit of THE Infinite Observable Harvest, you would receive infinite units between each unit, and infinite units between those, endlessly. This is density beyond sequence.|
The third construct remained dim, pulsing with light that seemed to contain all other lights while simultaneously transcending them.
|Third Boundary: Absolute Infinity.|
RUINATION’s voice grew more measured.
|At this Boundary, all other Infinities exist within you while you transcend them simultaneously. This Boundary is defined by having no boundaries.|
The construct refused to fully illuminate, refused to be fully perceived.
|No further information is available at your current classification. Understanding will come when we get closer to it.|
The diagram shifted to show Noah’s current state, each Depth displayed with its classification.
|Current Status of Your Depths.|
Four representations appeared, each showing one of his Depths.
|Surface Depth: Countable Infinity. Your Surface expressions regenerate in observable patterns.|
The Surface representation pulsed with sequential golden light.
|Intermediate Depth: Countable Infinity. Your Intermediate foundations pulse with sequential Infinite nature.|
The Intermediate representation matched the Surface, both showing orderly progression.
|Fundamental Depth: Countable Infinity. Stabilization required.|
The Fundamental representation flickered slightly, not yet fully stable in its Countable classification.
|Absolute Depth: Newly achieved. Classification pending, but Countable.|
The Absolute representation burned brightest of all, still in the process of settling into its new configuration.
A new diagram formed showing a path forward, showing methodology rather than merely classification.
|Advancement from Countable to Uncountable Infinity.|
RUINATION’s eyes burned brighter as she explained.

|The progression requires saturation rather than accumulation. Your current methodology involves receiving harvest and integrating it into your foundations. This builds Countable Infinity higher and higher, but it remains Countable.|
The diagram showed harvest flowing in, stacking upon itself, growing taller but not denser.
|To cross into Uncountable Infinity, you must overwhelm a Depth with harvest until no gaps remain between your Infinite expressions.This will require a lot. A LOT.|
The diagram shifted to show harvest not stacking but saturating, filling every possible space rather than merely adding to existing structures.

|THE Infinite Observable Harvest, with its Multiplicative Amplification and Exponential Expression, provides the density required for this saturation. When harvest flows not merely in sequence but in layers that fill every possible space within a Depth, the transition can occur.|
A practical example manifested.

|Practical Example: Your actions currently produce a harvest that flows toward you sequentially. If you were to concentrate THE Infinite Observable Harvest upon a single Depth until the harvest arriving between each nanosecond exceeded the harvest arriving within each nanosecond, saturation would begin. When saturation completes, Countable becomes Uncountable.|
The example showed the transition occurring, showed sequential becoming dense, showed Countable becoming Uncountable.

|Note: Progression at one Depth does not guarantee progression at others. Each Depth must be saturated independently. Surface Depth, being closest to external expression, is recommended as the first target for advancement.|
RUINATION’s form solidified as she finished her explanation, her blue-gold illusory presence settling into something that held weight beyond mere data processing. Her eyes met Noah’s with warmth!
|We... you, have come far, Master.|
Her smile held pride that felt genuine.
|And we have only just begun.|
He had come far.

Noah’s existence buzzed as he felt the grand and proper definitions of his Infinite Formless Depth without any variables or factors that came externally. No comparisons to THE Creature. No measurements against THE Primordial Paradox. Just him. Just his path. Just the endless architecture of what he was becoming.
He felt his Depths burning with the grandeur of Countable Infinity.

His Surface Depth pulsed with sequential golden light, each pulse followed by another in patterns he could observe and track. It felt like watching waves crash upon a shore, one after another, endless but rhythmic. He could sense each Infinite expression as it regenerated, could feel the first become the second become the third become the thousandth, all flowing in order that his consciousness could perceive.

His Intermediate Depth hummed with deeper resonance, the sequences there moving in currents that supported everything above them. It felt like standing atop an ocean and sensing the tides beneath, each wave of Infinity rising and falling in patterns that gave structure to his foundations.

His Fundamental Depth flickered with stabilizing Countable expressions, still settling into its new configuration but already displaying the sequential nature that defined this Boundary. It felt like roots extending into soil, each root followed by another, spreading endlessly but in order that could be traced.

And his newly achieved Absolute Depth burned brightest of all, the sequential Infinities there still arranging themselves into patterns that would define his presence among other Absolutes. It felt like a sun being born, each flame followed by another, the light endless but emerging in pulses that spoke of Countable nature.
After he felt this, he knew that he was just getting started!

Because he wanted to define and undefine things about himself so much more. To add and remove so much more! The architecture of his existence was vast and filled with potential that his previous comparative methodology had obscured. Now that he measured only against himself, he could see gaps that needed filling, structures that needed building, weavings that needed to be woven.
His existence expressed this desire and changed in response!

New configurations began forming within his Civilization, new possibilities emerging from the interaction between his Infinite nature and the choice he had just made. The transformation rippled through every aspect of what he was, reshaping capabilities that had existed in lesser forms into something that matched his elevated state!

RUINATION received these new inputs, her blue-gold form brightening as streams of information flowed into her consciousness through the infinite data points of her hair. Her eyes widened slightly with recognition of what was occurring, and then she smiled.
|Master, your existence is restructuring itself in response to your epiphany. New capabilities are emerging. Allow me to illustrate.|
She raised her hands, and the mindscape around them transformed!

Constructs of pure light began forming in the air, diagrams that displayed concepts in ways that transcended mere words. Lines of blue-gold authority curved through the space, connecting points that represented Noah’s capabilities to new configurations that were only now becoming possible.
|Geodesic Weavings have been unlocked in your existence.|

A massive construct appeared before them, showing two paths between two points. One path traveled in a straight line. The other curved gracefully, finding the natural geometry of the space between them.
|Your Depths now officially exist at Countable Infinity. This classification grants access to weavings that were previously impossible for your Civilization to produce.|
The diagram expanded, showing representations of Embodiments and Apophasis as straight arrows traveling from speaker to target.
|Standard Embodiments declare what IS. Standard Apophasis declares what IS NOT. These declarations travel from speaker to target through conventional pathways of authority.|
The straight arrows struck their targets and dissipated upon impact. Single effects. Finite duration. Limited reach.
Then the diagram shifted to show something new.
|Geodesic Weavings operate differently.|

Curved lines appeared, arcing gracefully through the space between origin and target. But these lines didn’t stop at impact. They continued extending, curving around obstacles, finding paths that the straight arrows couldn’t perceive.

|They extend infinitely toward their target while taking the shortest possible path through existence itself. Where Embodiments can be blocked and Apophasis can be resisted, Geodesic Weavings curve around obstacles, finding the natural line that connects your authority to your target with minimal distance and maximum efficiency.|
The curved lines demonstrated this, flowing around barriers that would have stopped conventional weavings, always finding the route that existence itself preferred.
A new construct formed beside the first, this one displaying detailed breakdown of the new classification.
|New Classification: Geodesic Declarations.|
The diagram showed a figure speaking words that extended outward not as single projectiles but as endless streams curving toward their destination.

|Geodesic Declarations are the evolution of Embodiments for you whose Depths exist at Countable Infinity. When you speak a Geodesic Declaration, your words do not merely travel toward the target. They extend infinitely in the direction of the target, curving through the fabric of existence to find the path of least resistance.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4947: Countable, Uncountable, Absolute! IV
paragraphs: Two examples manifested side by side.
|A standard Embodiment that declares "Your foundations weaken" affects the target once upon arrival.|
The first example showed a single impact, a single moment of weakening, then nothing.

|A Geodesic Declaration that states the same thing affects the target continuously along the entire infinite path connecting you to them. The weakening begins the moment you speak and never stops arriving, an endless stream of authority following the shortest curve through reality.|
The second example showed continuous impact, wave after wave of weakening arriving in sequence, each one building upon the last, the effect compounding endlessly.

|Geodesic Declarations incorporate your Countable Infinity directly. Each declaration carries sequential Infinite expressions that arrive one after another, endlessly. The target experiences not a single effect but an infinite sequence of effects that compound upon each other.|

Noah watched the demonstration with eyes that burned brighter with each revelation. The implications were fucking massive and utterly disastrous for others. What had been single strikes would become endless barrages. What had been momentary effects would become eternal conditions.
Another construct formed, this one darker, showing the negation of reality rather than the declaration of it.
|New Classification: Geodesic Negations.|
The diagram displayed words of denial curving through existence, seeking out everything that matched what was being negated.

|Geodesic Negations are the evolution of Apophasis for you whose Depths exist at Countable Infinity. When you speak a Geodesic Negation, your denial of reality curves through existence to find every instance of what you are negating.|
Two more examples manifested.
|A standard Apophasis that declares "Your defenses do not exist" removes the target’s defenses at the moment of impact.|
The first example showed defenses vanishing once, then slowly beginning to reform as the target recovered.

|A Geodesic Negation that states the same thing extends infinitely, negating the defenses not only as they currently are but as they attempt to regenerate, as they existed moments before, as they might exist in adjacent configurations. The negation follows the natural curve of existence to find and unmake all expressions of what was denied.|

The second example showed defenses vanishing and staying vanished, every attempt at reformation met with another wave of negation arriving along the geodesic path, the denial continuous and inescapable.

|Geodesic Negations incorporate Undifferentiation as a core component. What is negated does not merely cease to exist. It loses its differentiation entirely, returning to proto-potential that cannot reform into what it was. The negation extends infinitely along its geodesic path, ensuring that reformation becomes impossible.|
The diagram showed negated concepts dissolving into formless potential, unable to remember what they had been, unable to reconstitute themselves into what they were before.
RUINATION’s form shifted as she moved to a new section of the mindscape, new constructs forming around her that displayed Noah’s existing capabilities.
|Application to Archai.|
Representations of his Archai appeared, the Principles he had elevated through THE First Tongue now displaying new potential.
|Your Archai can now be elevated to Geodesic Archai. This represents the fusion of your Principles with Infinite geodesic expression.|
The first Arche manifested in detail.
|Geodesic Arche of Perpetual Harvest.|

The diagram showed harvest flowing from a collapsed enemy, but instead of stopping at the immediate resources, the harvest extended outward along curved paths that connected to everything the enemy had ever touched.

|Your harvest no longer merely claims resources from collapsed enemies. It extends infinitely along geodesic paths that curve through existence to find all resources connected to what you have claimed.|
The curved lines spread further and further, following connections that conventional harvest couldn’t perceive.

|When an enemy falls, the Geodesic Arche follows the natural lines connecting that enemy to everything they touched, everything they influenced, everything that owes its existence to them. The harvest arrives sequentially and endlessly, one connection after another, following the shortest paths through reality.|
Noah watched the demonstration with growing understanding. An enemy’s death would become a fountain that never stopped giving, harvest flowing along every connection that enemy had ever formed.
The second Arche manifested beside the first.
|Geodesic Arche of THE Cheating Architect.|
The diagram showed a rule being bent, but instead of the manipulation ending there, it propagated outward along curves that found every connected system.

|Your manipulation of rules and systems now extends infinitely along geodesic curves. When you alter a rule, the alteration follows the natural path connecting that rule to all other rules it influences.|
The bent rule created ripples that traveled along geodesic paths, each ripple bending another rule, each bent rule creating more ripples.

|The cheating propagates through existence along lines of least resistance, finding every system that can be bent and bending it in sequence. What was a single manipulation becomes an endless cascade of manipulations following the architecture of reality itself.|
New constructs formed showing behavioral patterns of these elevated weavings.
|Convergence and Divergence.|
Two scenarios manifested side by side, one showing geodesic paths narrowing toward a single point, the other showing them spreading outward to cover vast areas.

|Geodesic Weavings behave differently based on the nature of the space they travel through. In spaces of concentrated authority, your Geodesic Declarations and Negations converge, becoming more focused and more potent as they approach their target. In spaces of dispersed authority, they diverge, spreading to affect wider areas with distributed effect.|
The converging paths struck their target with combined force that exceeded their individual potencies. The diverging paths spread across regions, affecting everything within their expanding reach.

|You can influence this behavior through intent. A Geodesic Declaration meant to devastate a single target will converge. A Geodesic Negation meant to unmake a concept across a region will diverge. The Infinite nature of these weavings ensures that both convergence and divergence extend endlessly.|
RUINATION’s final construct appeared as a comprehensive comparison, showing old capabilities beside new ones in clear contrast.
|Comparative Assessment.|
The diagram split into two columns, the left showing what Noah had possessed before, the right showing what he possessed now.
|Standard Embodiment: Single declaration, single effect, can be blocked.|
|Geodesic Declaration: Infinite declaration extending along shortest path, continuous effect arriving endlessly, curves around obstacles through the natural geometry of existence.|
The contrast was stark. What had been a single punch became an endless barrage that couldn’t be evaded.
|Standard Apophasis: Single negation, removes target once, target may reform.|
|Geodesic Negation: Infinite negation extending along shortest path, incorporates Undifferentiation to prevent reformation, follows natural curves to find all instances of what is being denied.|
What had been a single deletion became permanent erasure that pursued its target through every possible configuration.
|Standard Archai: Principles expressed through elevated sentences of THE First Tongue.|

|Geodesic Archai: Principles extended infinitely along natural paths through existence, effects propagating sequentially along lines of least resistance, creating cascades of influence that follow the geometry of reality.|
What had been powerful expressions became endless cascades that followed the architecture of existence itself.
RUINATION’s eyes met Noah’s with profundity and wonder.

|Note: Geodesic Weavings require Depths at Countable Infinity to produce. Advancement to Uncountable Infinity will unlock further evolutions of these weavings. The nature of those evolutions is not yet known.|
She paused, allowing the information to settle into his consciousness.
|But we will discover them together, Master. As we always have.|
Oh.
Oh!

chapters.title: Chapter 4948: Defector I
paragraphs: The sensation was truly unlike any other.

It was like he was feeling something he already had, but it was now more defined. More understandable. The Infinite Mana that had always burned at his core hadn’t changed in quantity, but his perception of it had transformed entirely.
What had been a vast ocean without edges now revealed itself as an ocean with architecture, with depths that could be measured not against others but against the Boundaries of Infinity itself.
He had Infinite Mana, but now, it felt like there werelevelsto Infinite Mana!
Countable, Uncountable, and Absolute Infinities.
He thought about Countable Infinities first.
Noah raised his hand in his vibrant mindscape, the blue-gold light that surrounded him responding to his will with eagerness.

From his palm, a fireball erupted. Then another. Then another. Then another still. They flew outward in endless sequence, each one following the last in patterns that could be observed, that could be tracked, that could theoretically be listed: first fireball, second fireball, third fireball, onward forever.
This was Countable Infinity.

Endless, yes. Infinite, absolutely. But sequential. Ordered. Each expression following the previous one in progression that his consciousness could perceive. He could count them even if the counting would never end. First, second, third, fourth, thousandth, millionth, each one arriving after the one before it in patterns that existed within the First Boundary.
The fireballs continued erupting from his palm, filling his mindscape with endless light that demonstrated his current state perfectly. He understood now. He truly understood!

His Infinity wasn’t merely vast. It was vast in a specific way, a way that could be elevated, a way that could bedensified until the spaces between each fireball filled with additional fireballs that couldn’t be listed.
But that was for later.
For now, he wanted to test what Countable Infinity could do in combat.
Or even more straightforwardly...
"RUINATION, let me have a spar with...Bazuman."

He said such words grandly, his voice carrying through his mindscape with authority that made the endless fireballs pause in their eruption. The request was simple. He wanted to understand what his new capabilities could do against an enemy he had already faced, an enemy whose power he had witnessed firsthand, an enemy who had required THE Primordial Paradox’s intervention to defeat.
|Understood.|
RUINATION’s response was immediate, her blue-gold form brightening as she began the requested simulation.
His mental space churned with violent intensity!

The seas of blue Infinity that comprised his mindscape rumbled and roiled with force that made the very fabric of his consciousness tremble. Waves of light crashed against each other as something began taking shape in the distance, something massive, something hungry, something that remembered what it was and carried that memory into manifestation with terrifying fidelity.
A figure of Bazuman formed before Noah’s eyes!

The round chthonian horror materialized with all its ferocity and display of power intact. Countless crimson eyes arranged in spiraling patterns blazed with hunger that exceeded physical appetite. Innumerable tentacles tipped with mouths of crystallized memory reached outward in every direction. The corrupted proto-matter that covered its surface churned with faces of consumed beings, echoes of everything this horror had ever devoured.
The stomach split open at its center, revealing the pocket dimension of pure undifferentiation that had nearly claimed Noah in THE Prima Indifferentia!
Gravitational pull erupted from the manifestation with force that would have dragged any conventional opponent toward eternal dissolution.

Whisper Echoes poured forth from Bazuman’s surface, faint impressions of consumed beings launching attacks in overwhelming numbers. Memory Echoes followed, stronger manifestations wielding authority from before THE Infinite Unfurling. The air itself groaned under the weight of accumulated existence that this Undivided One carried.
This Manifestation of Bazuman unleashed the same grand attacks toward Noah that the original had displayed in THE Agora!

Tentacles reached for him with mouths screaming hunger. Echoes launched Embodiments from methodologies lost to history. Its core pulled at his existence with suction that sought to consume everything he was. The pressure of Bazuman’s undifferentiation pressed against his mindscape with weight that would have crushed lesser beings into formlessness.
Noah stood perfectly still.
Then he spoke.
"Your hunger does not exist."
HUUM!
The words emerged from his lips not as simple declaration but asGeodesic Negation!

The negation didn’t travel toward Bazuman in a straight line. It curved, finding the shortest path through the fabric of his mindscape, following the natural geometry of existence to reach its target with efficiency that transcended conventional authority.
The curve was beautiful in its precision, arcing through the space between Noah and Bazuman along routes that existence itself preferred.
And when it arrived, it didn’t merely arrive once.
The negation struck Bazuman’s hunger and unmade it on its Surface, Intermediate, Fundamental, and Absolute Depths!
Because Noah had Countable infinities...for all his Depths, so he affected all the Depths of his enemy!

The gravitational pull of its core vanished as the hunger driving it ceased to exist. But unlike conventional Apophasis, the negation didn’t stop there. It extended infinitely along its geodesic path, continuing to curve through Bazuman’s existence, finding every instance of hunger that this Undivided One possessed.
The hunger tried to regenerate.
The negation found that regeneration and unmade it before it could complete.
The hunger attempted to manifest in different configurations, drawing upon echoes of consumed beings who had possessed their own forms of appetite.
The negation curved to find those adjacent configurations and unmade them as well.

Every expression of hunger that Bazuman possessed, every instance of appetite that drove its consumption, every configuration of desire that had accumulated across eons of devouring existence, the Geodesic Negation found them all along curved paths of minimal distance. And it unmade them!
Not once. Not twice. Infinitely. Sequentially! One negation following another following another in Countable progression that never ceased arriving!
Noah came to realize the terror of the capability that he had unlocked as casting a single ability...was effectively like casting infinite abilities!
So even though he didn’t do anything extra or additional, it was like he was constantly unleashing more and more Apophasis, which were Geodesic Negations in this case.
It was fucking disgusting!

chapters.title: Chapter 4949: Defector II
paragraphs: The mouths on Bazuman’s tentacles went slack, forgetting what it meant to hunger.
The stomach’s pull dissipated entirely, the dimension within losing the drive that made it consume.
The echoes that had been attacking faltered as the hunger animating them dissolved into undifferentiated potential that couldn’t remember what appetite felt like.
But Bazuman was still there. Still massive. Still filled with power beyond imagination.
It tried to attack through means other than hunger, tried to use the authority of consumed beings, tried to manifest echoes through memory rather than appetite.
Noah spoke again.
"Your existence crystallizes with the definition of Infinity."
BOOM!
The Geodesic Declaration erupted from him with force that exceeded the negation!

Where the negation had unmade, the declaration made. Where the negation had denied, the declaration affirmed. The words curved toward Bazuman along geodesic paths that found the shortest route through his mindscape, following the natural geometry of existence with precision that couldn’t be evaded.
And the declaration didn’t merely arrive once.
It arrived infinitely!

The first wave of the declaration struck Bazuman and began defining its existence with Infinity. Blue-gold light spread across the Undivided One’s surface as the declaration imposed definition upon undifferentiation. But before that first wave could complete its work, the second wave arrived along the same geodesic path. Then the third. Then the fourth. Then the thousandth. Then the millionth.
Each wave of declaration built upon the previous one, the definition compounding endlessly as sequential expressions of Countable Infinity crashed into Bazuman without cessation.
The Geodesic Negation continued curving through Bazuman’s existence, finding every attempt at hunger and unmaking it before it could form.
The Geodesic Declaration continued curving along its own path, defining every aspect of Bazuman with Infinity that couldn’t be denied.
The two weavings worked in harmony, one preventing resistance while the other imposed transformation.

Bazuman’s countless crimson eyes widened with something that might have been horror as definition spread across its form faster than its undifferentiated nature could counter. The echoes it tried to manifest found themselves defined before they could attack. The memories it tried to use found themselves crystallized into Infinite patterns that served Noah rather than their consumed origins.
The tentacles that had reached for Noah went rigid as definition claimed them.
The mouths that had screamed hunger fell silent as the negation continued denying their appetite.
That terrifying dimension of pure undifferentiation, found itself filling with definition that made dissolution impossible.

Wave after wave of Geodesic Declaration crashed into Bazuman, each one following the previous in sequential order, each one adding more definition to what the previous wave had begun. The Undivided One that had required THE Primordial Paradox’s freezing authority to defeat now found itself frozen by something else entirely.
Not by paradox, but by Infinity itself.

The crystallization spread from Bazuman’s exterior to its interior, from its surface to its core, from its physical form to its Civilizational Manifestation. Blue-gold light overwhelmed the crimson of its eyes. Definition replaced the undifferentiation that had comprised its existence since before THE Infinite Unfurling.
And then...
Bazuman became crystallized entirely!

The horror that had consumed countless beings across eons of existence stood frozen in Noah’s mindscape, its form now comprised entirely of blue-gold Infinity that declared what it was with authority that couldn’t be questioned. Every aspect of its existence had been defined. Every instance of its hunger had been negated. Every possibility of resistance had been unmade before it could manifest.
Silence settled over the mindscape.
The manifestation of Bazuman shattered!
Fragments of defined Infinity scattered across Noah’s consciousness before dissolving into the blue-gold light that comprised his mental space.

What had been one of the most terrifying entities in Observable Existence disappeared without fanfare, without drama, without any of the struggle that had characterized their actual battle in THE Agora.
Just a demonstration.
Just a test.
Just proof of what Geodesic Weavings could accomplish.

Calmness returned to the mindscape as the last fragments of Bazuman’s manifestation faded into nothing. The seas of blue Infinity settled back into their eternal churning, the violent roiling subsiding into peaceful waves that spoke of power waiting to be used rather than power being used.
RUINATION’s form solidified beside Noah, her eyes burning with analysis that had been processing every aspect of the simulation.
|Assessment Complete.|
She gestured, and prompts bloomed before Noah’s eyes.
|If Bazuman was faced right now, THE Primordial Paradox would not be needed to hold him down. You could defeat him one against one with a single Geodesic Negation and a single Geodesic Declaration.|
The words settled into his awareness.

|This is the power you have grasped after attaining Absolute with your Derivative Civilizations and taking the leap to be truer to your Infinities. Your decision to abandon comparative measurement has not merely changed how you perceive your growth. It has fundamentally elevated what your growth produces.|
Her eyes met his with something that approached awe!
Existence was vast and filled with possibilities and impossibilities.
The weak thought they understood existence and how vast it was, and this was why they remained weak.

They built their understanding upon foundations of assumption, upon scaffolding of certainty that had no right to be certain. They looked at the sky and believed they saw its limits. They looked at the depths and believed they saw their endings.Their confidence in comprehension was the very chain that bound them to mediocrity.
The strong knew their own inadequacy.

They knew that there was actually much they didn’t know about Existence. They had peered into the abyss and felt the abyss peer back, had touched the edges of understanding and felt those edges recede further with every step they took toward them.The strong were humble before the vastness, not because humility was virtuous, but because humility was accurate.
It was too much for a single mind to comprehend!

At this moment, THE Wastes of Observable Existence permeated and expanded as the recent actions of THE Living Paradox had unleashed too many things. The corruption that flowed from THE Prima Indifferentia had transformed regions that had been stable for eons into territories of chaos and opportunity.
Boundaries that had held since THE First Cause now wavered like candle flames before a storm.

THE Prima Indifferentia itself was corrupted and opened freely to Observable Existence as entities that had been unseen since THE First Cause now moved with purpose that transcended mortal understanding. Things that had slumbered in the spaces between differentiation and undifferentiation now stirred, awakened by the corruption that called to them like a mother calling to children long separated!

It has fundamentally elevated what your growth produces.|
Her eyes met his with something that approached awe!
Existence was vast and filled with possibilities and impossibilities.
The weak thought they understood existence and how vast it was, and this was why they remained weak.
They built their understanding upon foundations of assumption, upon scaffolding of certainty that had no right to be certain.
They looked at the sky and believed they saw its limits.
They looked at the depths and believed they saw their endings.Their confidence in comprehension was the very chain that bound them to mediocrity.
The strong knew their own inadequacy.
They knew that there was actually much they didn’t know about Existence.

They had peered into the abyss and felt the abyss peer back, had touched the edges of understanding and felt those edges recede further with every step they took toward them.The strong were humble before the vastness, not because humility was virtuous, but because humility was accurate.
It was too much for a single mind to comprehend!
At this moment, THE Wastes of Observable Existence permeated and expanded as the recent actions of THE Living Paradox had unleashed too many things.
The corruption that flowed from THE Prima Indifferentia had transformed regions that had been stable for eons into territories of chaos and opportunity.
Boundaries that had held since THE First Cause now wavered like candle flames before a storm.

THE Prima Indifferentia itself was corrupted and opened freely to Observable Existence as entities that had been unseen since THE First Cause now moved with purpose that transcended mortal understanding.
Things that had slumbered in the spaces between differentiation and undifferentiation now stirred, awakened by the corruption that called to them like a mother calling to children long separated!

chapters.title: Chapter 4950: Defector III
paragraphs: "You could do everything right in existence. You could plan for all contingencies and possibilities. But sometimes, shit just happens." -THE Genesis Monarch, Unknown Time.
At this time, near a Shelter of THE Loom that had its massive door struck open, a scene unfolded that showed conquest dressed in the robes of salvation.

Early Creatures and Living Elementals were situated in neat rows, their forms pressed against the barren ground of THE Wastes in postures of submission that their existence had never been designed to assume. They knelt with heads bowed, their authorities diminished, their pride extinguished by force that exceeded their capacity to resist.
They all looked toward the man responsible for breaking into their Shelter and dragging them out here.
A young man with dark hair and a silver robe stood before them with the bearing of one who believed himself right!

His features were handsome in the way that sculptures were handsome, beautiful but cold. His eyes burned with conviction that had long ago ceased questioning itself, faith that had calcified into certainty, purpose that had forgotten how to doubt.
He was surrounded by the allure of Law.

Silver light emanated from his form in patterns of order imposed rather than order discovered. After an Embodiment from THE Creature, he, or really the weavings of THE Living Law within him, had allowed his Immensity to rise almost past Fundamental Depth. He stood at heights that most beings couldn’t reach across eons of cultivation, elevated not through his own effort but through the investment of another.
And at this moment, he was laying down peace with force.
For he was THE Peacemaker, Alexander Asmodeus!

With the Early Creatures and Living Elementals bowing to him, his Enneagram spun like a heavy wheel on his chest, its nine points burning with silver light that absorbed the weavings of those who knelt before him. Their existences flowed into his construct, their authorities becoming fuel for his ascension, their potential becoming foundation for his growth.
This was peace as he understood it now. Not the absence of conflict, but the presence of submission. Not harmony achieved through understanding, but silence achieved through dominance.
As he did all this, in his mind, a voice echoed out with warmth that belied its calculations.

"Once we finish with this Shelter, we can go on to progressively more fortified ones. As you enact your version of peace and Law, we can continue building up your foundation until Absolute is not far away..."
Alex nodded at these words as he was about to continue his harvest of submission when...
HUUM!
Everything around them began to shake.

The ground of THE Wastes, which had no true ground, trembled with vibrations that exceeded physical causation. The air, which held no true air, grew thick with pressure that made breathing an act of will rather than instinct. The light, which had no true source, flickered with uncertainty of something ancient stirring from slumber that had lasted since before THE Infinite Unfurling.
Alex’s eyes widened as he felt his silver authority waver against pressure that exceeded anything he had prepared for.
Not from above.
Not from the sides.
But from below!

In THE Wastes of THE Fallout, direction held no meaning. What was below could be above. What was left could be right. The corruption that permeated this region had long ago unmade the certainties of spatial orientation. And yet, somehow, what was happening was definitely happening from below them all.
Two massive eyes opened in the depths beneath existence itself.
They were gigaparsecs in size.

The scale of them exceeded comprehension, exceeded the frameworks that mortal minds used to process magnitude, exceeded even the elevated perceptions of beings who had touched THE Civilizational Scale.
Each eye was larger than clusters of Wheels of Existence or Folds, larger than anything that had manifested in Observable Existence for quite some time.

The eyes were crimson, but not the crimson of blood or fire or passion. This was the crimson of undifferentiation given visual form, the color that existence wore when it forgot what color meant. Their surfaces swirled with spirals within spirals that seemed to drill into the consciousness of anyone who looked upon them.
And they held light.

Terrifying light of undifferentiation that made THE Living Paradox’s corruption seem like a child’s painting beside a masterwork as at this moment...they held corruption, and they held glimmers of infinities!
When they opened fully, that light erupted outward!

For an unfathomable distance, a cataclysmic crimson radiance spread like a tide that knew no shore. It washed across THE Wastes with speed that exceeded the concept of speed, illuminating everything it touched with undifferentiation that seeped into the very fabric of what it illuminated.
Shelters that had stood for eons found their walls suddenly uncertain of whether they were walls. Beings that had defined themselves across countless moments found their definitions wavering.
The light was so pervasive and widespread that nothing could escape its reach.

Countless Gigaparsecs away, the figure of Alex found himself bathed in crimson radiance that pressed against his silver authority with weight that exceeded anything THE Living Law had prepared him to face.
His Enneagram, which had been spinning with confident purpose, now stuttered and slowed as the light of undifferentiation challenged the very concept of Law itself.

The Early Creatures and Living Elementals who had been kneeling to him, their submission complete and their resistance broken, now found themselves covered by this light as well. But where Alex struggled against it, they simply received it. They had already been defeated. They had already given up their autonomy. What was one more master to beings who had already accepted mastery?
It was like being branded by horror itself.

On their foreheads, insignias began to form with heat that exceeded physical temperature. Crimson light carved itself into their existences with authority that couldn’t be questioned, that couldn’t be resisted, that couldn’t be bargained with.
The insignia looked like a crimson circle with a line crossing diagonally through it.
Simple. Ancient. Absolute!
Oh!

It was the mark of ownership that predated the concept of ownership, the brand of servitude that had been old when THE Infinite Unfurling was young, the signature of a being that had existed since differentiation itself first emerged from the proto-potential of what came before!
Around Alex, illustrious silver light flashed with desperate intensity!

He sought to resist this terrifying power of undifferentiation with everything THE Living Law had invested in him. His Enneagram spun faster, trying to impose order upon chaos that exceeded order’s jurisdiction. His silver robes blazed with authority that declared him protected, declared him invested, declared him backed by powers that should have been sufficient.
It did not work.

The crimson light pressed through his silver defenses as if they were suggestions rather than barriers. THE Living Law’s investment, which had seemed so grand against Early Creatures and Living Elementals, revealed itself as insufficient against authority that had shaped existence itself. Alex’s resistance was not even acknowledged. It was simply bypassed, as one might step over an insect while walking toward one’s destination.
The insignia formed on his forehead with the same inevitability that it had formed on all the others.
Crimson circle. Diagonal line!

chapters.title: Chapter 4951: Defector IV
paragraphs: His eyes, which had burned with silver conviction moments before, now blazed with crimson light that overwrote everything he had believed himself to be. His purpose, his mission, his certainty, all of it dissolved into undifferentiation that served a will older than THE Infinite Unfurling.
A booming ancient voice echoed across the vastness with weight that pressed against the very concept of hearing.
"YOU ARE ALL NOW SLAVES OF THE PRIMORDIAL ARCHITECT, HORUS."
The words were not loud. They were simply everywhere.
"TOIL AWAY AND ELEVATE YOURSELVES FOR HORUS."
Each syllable carried the weight of commandment that preceded the existence of language.
"BUILD YOUR CIVILIZATIONS FOR HORUS."
The instructions were simple. The obedience they demanded was absolute.
"TOIL, AND PERSEVERE."

After this terrifying proclamation, the figure of Alex and all others who had been kneeling forcefully shifted into seated meditative positions. Their bodies moved without their permission, their limbs arranging themselves into postures of cultivation that their minds had not chosen. Their eyes burned with the insignia that had branded them, crimson light replacing whatever had filled their gazes before.
Their very weavings of existence began to burn for the sake of forcefully elevating their Civilizations!

It was not cultivation as they had known it. It was not growth chosen and directed. It was consumption of self for the benefit of another, the burning of one’s own potential to fuel progress that would serve Horus rather than themselves. By the time they progressed and made gains in their Civilizations, their very existence may just be spent entirely.
They would grow stronger.
And in growing stronger, they would grow emptier.
Until nothing remained but hollow vessels of power that served a master they had never chosen.
None of the beings here had expected this to be happening.

THE Peacemaker had never expected this to be happening. He had possessed power. He had possessed connections, tied to THE Creature through THE Living Law, and also tied to...THE Genesis Monarch as he sought his own path when he left him!
He had possessed plans, carefully laid methodologies for achieving peace through dominance across THE Wastes. Everything had been arranged. Everything had been prepared. Everything had been certain!
But sometimes, even if you had everything, even if you had all these plans, even if you had power and backing and connections...
Shit happened.
Existence did not care about preparations. THE Primordial Architects did not care about investments.
Horus did not care that Alexander Asmodeus had been destined for greatness, that THE Living Law had chosen him, that THE Creature had empowered.
Horus cared only that there was potential to be harvested.
And so Horus harvested.
But the awakening of ancient eyes did not go unnoticed.

In the skies above THE Wastes, or perhaps below them, or perhaps beside them in directions that held no names, a multicolored flaming visage manifested with presence that pressed against the crimson light with weight of its own.
THE Creature!

His manifestation stared at the distant pair of gigaparsec eyes with coldness that exceeded the clinical, that spoke of recognition between beings who had known each other since before most of existence had been differentiated. The multicolored flames that comprised his visage burned with patterns that challenged the crimson undifferentiation, imposing diversity where Horus sought obedience.
And beside him, another figure appeared.

An entity that looked like a scholar stepped into visibility with presence that belied his humble appearance. He wore simple black robes without adornment, without insignia, without any of the marks that powerful beings typically used to declare their status.
His appearance was clean, every aspect of his presentation carefully considered.
His eyes were bright with possibility and somberness in equal measure, intelligence that had witnessed too much balanced against hope that refused to be extinguished despite everything it had seen.
It was Anaximander.
THE Creature’s oldest friend. THE First Scholar! Jokul Anaximander!

Anaximander looked over to the massive eyes that still blazed with crimson undifferentiation, that still pressed their brand upon everything within their unfathomable reach. His expression held grief for the beings being consumed.
"Well, you wanted Adversity, my friend."
His voice was calm despite everything that was occurring, steady despite the horror that surrounded them.
"Now, Adversity is knocking at your door."

With these words hanging in the corrupted air, the body of THE Creature was silent and contemplative briefly before he began to shine with multicolored radiance that exceeded his previous manifestation!
In THE Wastes, this brilliant light of existence illuminated everything, pressing back against the crimson undifferentiation.
The multicolored light shot outward toward the pair of gigaparsec eyes with speed that exceeded comprehension, with force that exceeded calculation, with intent that exceeded mere opposition.
THE Creature was attacking a Primordial Architect.

The pair of eyes remained cold and devoid of any emotion as they observed the approaching assault. There was no fear in those massive crimson depths. There was no concern. There was not even curiosity.
For this...was not a being of THE First Scale.
A booming voice stretched out, echoing across vast landscapes with weight that exceeded the previous commandments.
"DEFECTOR."
BOOM!
Defector.

This single word boomed out across existence with implications that exceeded its simple syllables. It spoke of history that predated THE Infinite Unfurling, of choices made when existence was young, of paths diverged when paths were first being formed.
THE Creature had been something else before he became THE Creature!
And Horus remembered!
Oh!
After the stage was set by THE Living Paradox, many of those affected began to move as truly, at this time, what was happening was Observable Existence becoming more alive.
More alive with vibrancy that exceeded peaceful slumber.
More alive with activity that exceeded quiet contemplation.
More alive with complex weavings of existence that exceeded simple patterns of growth and decay.

If existence had been slumbering before, leaning back on a chair of complacency while eons passed in comfortable predictability, existence had now sat upright with grand attention that missed nothing.

Eyes that had been half-closed now opened fully. Ears that had been listening casually now strained to catch every whisper. Hands that had been resting now reached for weapons that had gathered dust for too long.
Everything was about to be much more illustrious.
Everything was about to be much more complex.
Everything was about to be much more brutal.

There had been THE Infinite Unfurling. There had been THE Earliest Folds. There had been an era where THE Belly of Existence held countess beings while THE Loom held countless others. Now, a new Era was blooming!

chapters.title: Chapter 4952: Truly Live! I
paragraphs: In THE Wastes.
Moments before.
Noah’s body here stood with the fisherman and his very good dog, Skoll, as they were looking up and down at the humanoid figure of THE Great Usurper, Eckert.
The being before them defied conventional understanding of progression!

Where others struggled and strived and fought against existence to claim greater heights, Eckert had achieved something that bordered on impossibility. He had grown through the absence of action. He had elevated through the presence of stillness.
His path was the paradox of the unmoved mover given flesh, the jest of a being who gained by refusing to grasp.

He should have been worse for wear as a Crack in Observable Existence had bloomed exactly where his weavings were covering. The corruption of THE Living Paradox had spread through that Crack, the proto-matter flooding into regions that should have been devastated by such contact. Any normal existence would have been consumed or transformed or unmade entirely.
But the result that actually occurred was the ridiculous wonder of his weavings integrating and beginning to spread within THE Wastes and THE Prima Indifferentia.
His idle existence, by doing absolutely nothing and remaining idle, was now permeating into THE Prima Indifferentia.

The consequence was, of course, the unique Depth of this being becoming ridiculously grand and reinforced. His foundation grew heavier with every moment he chose not to act. His authority expanded with every decision he declined to make. His power accumulated through the simple fact of his continued refusal to use it.

When Noah looked at such a disgusting path of progression, even though he himself had just proceeded to unlock ridiculous wonders that made him powerful in ways that others would barely be able to understand, he felt the path of THE Great Usurper was truly something else entirely.
And this being was looking at him seriously.

Eckert’s eyes held calculation that his idle demeanor typically concealed. There was ambition behind that pretense of inaction. He had chosen not to act for so long, but choice implied the capacity to choose otherwise. And right now, that capacity was stirring.
"I have been idle for quite some time. The gains from it are immense."
His voice emerged with weight!
"But right now, I really want to be a bit more active."
"I want to meet this entity that holds an ability similar to mine and yet is utilizing it in a much grander fashion."
He paused, his gaze growing distant as if perceiving things beyond the immediate vicinity.
"Since part of my existence is now this composition of corrupted proto-matter and Infinite Seals that should be... yours?"
He glanced at Noah with something approaching curiosity.

"Since all of this is pervasively spreading out across Observable Existence, I could allow it to flow where THE Entity has those she has put under control. And I can see exactly what reaction there could be between me and them."
His stillness seemed to deepen rather than diminish as he considered the implications.
"Whether they would be able to take me over, or I take them over. It’s dangerous, but..."
A light of ambition seemed to burn in his eyes!
At this time...
HUUM!
Everything changed.

The sensation struck Noah’s existence before his perception could process what was occurring. It was pressure from below, from a direction that THE Wastes shouldn’t have possessed, from depths that existence itself had forgotten existed. The weight of it pressed against his foundations with a force that exceeded anything the corruption of THE Living Paradox had produced!
Two massive eyes opened in the depths beneath everything.

The scale of them exceeded comprehension entirely. Noah’s elevated perception, his Absolute Vision of Existence, his Geodesic awareness that curved through reality along paths of minimal distance, all of it struggled to process what he was witnessing.
The eyes occupied space that shouldn’t have been occupiable. They existed in ways that challenged the very concept of existence.
Crimson light erupted from those impossible depths!
The undifferentiation within that light was terrifying!
This was not the corruption of THE Living Paradox, and not the consumption methodology of Bazuman, and not even the unity-seeking infection of THE Primordial Mycelia.
This was undifferentiation at its source, at its origin!

The light spread across THE Wastes with speed that transcended speed, with reach that transcended reach, with authority that transcended authority. It touched everything. It pressed against everything. It sought to brand everything with ownership!
Noah felt it pressing against his existence as he... spoke.
"My existence is shielded by Infinite definition that curves through all paths toward my protection."
BOOM!
The Geodesic Declaration erupted from him with force that exceeded anything he had previously manifested!

The words curved along geodesic paths, finding the natural geometry of existence, following routes of minimal resistance to establish protection. Blue-gold light blazed around his form as the declaration took shape, crystallizing into a circular shield filled with Infinities that burned with sequential patterns of Countable expression.
The shield formed around him, around the fisherman, around Skoll, around THE Great Usurper.
And the crimson light of undifferentiation crashed against it!
BOOM!

The impact was staggering. Noah felt his Geodesic Declaration straining against pressure that exceeded what he had anticipated. The shield held, yes, but it held through continuous effort rather than effortless supremacy. Each wave of crimson undifferentiation that struck the barrier was met with another wave of Infinite definition curving along geodesic paths to reinforce what had been challenged.

The sequential nature of his Countable Infinity revealed itself as both strength and limitation. His defense arrived endlessly, one reinforcement following another following another, but the crimson light pressed with weight that seemed to exist outside of sequence entirely.
It was undifferentiation from before differentiation had learned to count, from before sequence had learned to sequence!
His barrier held.
But it was heavily strained even as it did its job.

Noah stared down at the crimson eyes that seemed to be occupying nearly all space all around. They gazed back with coldness that exceeded temperature, with patience that exceeded time, with authority that exceeded the frameworks through which authority was typically understood.
Those eyes seemed like...they had seen existence take its first differentiated breath. Those eyes remembered what had been forgotten!

"You are all now slaves of THE Primordial Architect, Horus."

The being before them defied conventional understanding of progression!

He had grown through the absence of action.
He had elevated through the presence of stillness.
His path was the paradox of the unmoved mover given flesh, the jest of a being who gained by refusing to grasp.
He should have been worse for wear as a Crack in Observable Existence had bloomed exactly where his weavings were covering.
The corruption of THE Living Paradox had spread through that Crack, the proto-matter flooding into regions that should have been devastated by such contact.
Any normal existence would have been consumed or transformed or unmade entirely.
But the result that actually occurred was the ridiculous wonder of his weavings integrating and beginning to spread within THE Wastes and THE Prima Indifferentia.
His idle existence, by doing absolutely nothing and remaining idle, was now permeating into THE Prima Indifferentia.
The consequence was, of course, the unique Depth of this being becoming ridiculously grand and reinforced.
His foundation grew heavier with every moment he chose not to act.
His authority expanded with every decision he declined to make.
His power accumulated through the simple fact of his continued refusal to use it.

When Noah looked at such a disgusting path of progression, even though he himself had just proceeded to unlock ridiculous wonders that made him powerful in ways that others would barely be able to understand, he felt the path of THE Great Usurper was truly something else entirely.
And this being was looking at him seriously.
Eckert’s eyes held calculation that his idle demeanor typically concealed.
There was ambition behind that pretense of inaction.
He had chosen not to act for so long, but choice implied the capacity to choose otherwise.
And right now, that capacity was stirring.

His voice emerged with weight!

"I want to meet this entity that holds an ability similar to mine and yet is utilizing it in a much grander fashion."

chapters.title: Chapter 4953: Truly Live! II
paragraphs: The words pressed against Noah’s shield with a weight that exceeded the crimson light itself. They were a commandment given form, a will made manifest, and authority that predated the existence of resistance!
"Toil away and elevate yourselves for Horus. Build your civilizations for Horus. Toil, and Persevere."
Noah felt the words trying to find purchase within his existence, trying to establish a brand!
His Geodesic Declaration curved to intercept them, his Infinite definition denying the ownership that Horus sought to impose.
He remained unbranded.
His shield held, but he could feel how close it had been.
Then, in an area extremely far away, a brilliant multicolored light of existence flashed with intensity.
Noah recognized it immediately.
THE Creature.

The light reminded him of the Absolute Effigy he had witnessed in Alfheimr, of the multicolored flames that had surrounded that ancient being’s manifestation. But this was more than mere presence. This was assault and challenge. This was one titan announcing itself to another!
An instant later, the terrifying light of undifferentiation that was pressing down all around became tremendously weaker!

The crimson radiance that had been straining Noah’s Geodesic Declaration suddenly lessened in intensity, its attention divided, its authority contested by something that could actually contest it. His shield stopped straining. His Infinite definitions stopped working so hard to maintain themselves.
Something was fighting THE Primordial Architect, Horus!
And across THE Wastes, a word echoed with implications that exceeded its simple syllables.
"Defector."
The word boomed through existence! It was accusation and recognition simultaneously.
Another instant later, all of THE Wastes of THE Fallout vibrated and trembled!

It was as if reality itself was quaking, as if the foundations upon which THE Wastes had been built were shaking from impacts that exceeded what foundations were designed to withstand. The shaking wasn’t localized. It spread across distances that defied measurement, affecting regions that had no connection to each other except through the vastness of THE Wastes itself.
But truly, it was only the impacts of utterly terrifying things going head to head.
When titans fought, the masses could only huddle and hug each other for warmth, hoping that these titans didn’t have their battle cross where they were and decimate everything.
A conflict played out above mortal comprehension, forces that shaped existence itself clashing in ways that existence itself could barely contain!
The crimson eyes that had bloomed seemingly across all of THE Wastes faded moments later.
The crimson light of undifferentiation faded away.
And THE Wastes routinely continued to shake!

Each tremor spoke of blows being exchanged, of authorities being contested, of powers that exceeded Absolute clashing in combat that most beings would never be able to witness or comprehend. The battle had moved elsewhere, but its echoes remained, vibrating through reality like ripples from stones thrown into an infinite pond.
THE Great Usurper looked around with expression that had finally abandoned his pretense of stillness entirely.
"What the hell just happened?"
His voice held genuine uncertainty.
Noah’s reply was calm and somber, his eyes still fixed on a distance where multicolored light continued to clash with something unseen.
"It should be a battle between monsters. A Primordial Architect and..."
He didn’t finish his words.

He remembered feeling the glimpse of THE Creature in THE Wastes. He remembered the multicolored light that had flashed with intensity exceeding everything else. He remembered the word that Horus had spoken with weight of ancient accusation.
Defector.

THE Primordial Architect, Horus, the being that had just tried to exert their terrifying influence across these vast distances, had said that word as if he was referring to THE Creature. Then THE Creature had to have defected from the same weavings as Horus.
Which would theoretically make THE Creature a Primordial Architect.
Or rather, in this case, he was not any longer.
Noah still had his other body before THE Creature in Alfheimr as it seemed their conversation was coming to an end. He could always satisfy his curiosity to ask about this.

If THE Creature had once been a Primordial Architect, if he had defected from that classification to become what he was now, what did that mean for the nature of Primordial Architects themselves? What did that mean for the path that lay ahead?
He had many thoughts swirling in his mind, but he looked out across the expanse of THE Wastes all around him as he affirmed something fundamental.
Terrifying monsters were about to run free all around.

Some of them would be as terrifying as THE Five. Some would likely be even grander. At this moment, he couldn’t rule out something at THE Second Scale of Existence having been released from THE Prima Indifferentia. The corruption had opened doors that had been closed since THE First Cause, had awakened things that had been sleeping since before THE Infinite Unfurling.
And yet even with such a thought, even knowing all the problems that were echoing out all around, Noah welcomed it.
All of this was Adversity.
And Adversity would only mean that there would be some pain, but the gain from it would be even grander. The weavings of suffering resolved itself through this simple understanding!

Pain existed to produce growth. Struggle existed to produce strength. The monsters that now roamed free were not merely threats. They were opportunities. They were teachers. They were whetstones upon which he would sharpen himself until his edge could cut through anything.
As he thought about this, he turned over to The Fisherman, Ains, and Skoll.

The very good dog looked at him with eyes that held loyalty exceeding mere instinct. His tail wagged with enthusiasm that seemed almost comical given the apocalyptic events that had just occurred. Skoll didn’t understand the implications of what had happened, didn’t comprehend the horror that had just attempted to brand all existence. He only knew that Noah was here, and that was enough.
Noah smiled slightly at this display of pure, uncomplicated devotion.
"Let’s unlock your full potential, shall we? My Infinite Seals have not yet expressed themselves through you as now that they are Countable Infinities..."
He trailed off, considering the implications.
To awaken Skoll, he had infused this very good boy with his 27 Seals. Since then, his Seals had changed tremendously.
Skoll would change as well.

He also looked over to The Fisherman. Ains had witnessed things that most beings would never witness, had survived events that should have ended existences far stronger than his. But his path required more than witnessing. His path required struggle.
He would be sent to THE Yggdrheim.
And THE Great Usurper...

Noah turned to Eckert with eyes that burned with golden Infinity. This being who had grown through stillness, who had progressed through the paradox of non-progression, needed something that his idle path couldn’t provide.
He needed to move, and he needed to act.
He needed to confront rather than avoid.
"And...let’s go ahead and throw you in the folds of Adversity, shall we?"

chapters.title: Chapter 4954: Truly Live! III
paragraphs: Noah knew that Observable Existence was getting more and more dangerous.

Today a terrifying Primordial Architect named Horus had made themselves abundantly apparent, their crimson eyes opening across gigaparsecs of space, their brand seeking to claim all who fell beneath their gaze. But others were not as showy. It was certain that as of right now, an unknown number of Formless Terrors, Undivided Ones, and Primordial Architects were running around freely across Observable Existence.

They could be in these very Wastes. They could be in Primordial Realms or in the Wandering Territories or in any of the myriad transformed Folds. The corruption of THE Living Paradox had opened doors that had been sealed since THE First Cause, had awakened things that had slumbered since before THE Infinite Unfurling gave shape to what now existed.
Coming across one, if one wasn’t powerful enough, would be catastrophic.
Because what happened the next time that THE Creature didn’t appear?

If Noah met a Primordial Architect like that entity that had just appeared, even though he was immense and unfathomable right now, would he be able to do anything against them? Or would his fate be to become a slave, branded with that crimson circle, his existence burned away to fuel the elevation of another?
The mere thought caused the sense of defiance to rage within his Infinities!
His tyranny blazed with rejection of such a fate, with denial of such a possibility, with determination that exceeded mere stubbornness!
He burned with determination!
He would not accept a fate written by another. He would write his own destiny with authority that curved along geodesic paths toward whatever end he chose.
He knew he had to keep moving even quicker.

He needed to apply the weavings of Countable Infinities, the Geodesic Weavings of his existence, to many more things! Every aspect of his Civilization that hadn’t yet been elevated needed to be elevated. Every capability that still operated through conventional methodology needed to be transformed. Every portion of his existence that remained vulnerable needed to be reinforced.
And so he began this process as many of his bodies continued to move.
In Alfheimr.

In that region where he and THE Creature were conversing with their massive Absolute Effigies displayed, the multicolored stellar space still surrounded them with light that painted everything in shades that shouldn’t have existed. The battle between THE Creature and Horus had moved elsewhere, but echoes of it still vibrated through the fabric of this space, tremors that spoke of titans clashing in distances too vast to comprehend.
Noah looked up toward THE Creature at this moment, his golden Effigy burning with Infinite Undifferentiated Fate that pulsed in sequential patterns of Countable expression. His eyes held curiosity.

"A Primordial Architect called Horus very loudly just announced himself and acted across THE Wastes. Can you tell me anything about him or others like him that can be expected to be moving across existence right now?"

His path and the path of THE Creature were different. He wouldn’t ask for help with his own Adversities, wouldn’t seek assistance with battles that were his to fight. But he could always ask for information. Knowledge freely given carried no debt. Understanding offered without strings attached created no obligation.
THE Creature’s multicolored Effigy burned steadily as those swirling eyes fixed upon Noah with light of profundity.
"Horus is one among many."
The statement was simple, but its implications were vast.

"Primordial Architects are the existences that rose first. The first life forms during the emergence of THE First Cause. Some were born at the First Civilizational Scale of Existence. Others were born at THE Second Scale of Existence."
His multicolored flames flickered with patterns of memory being accessed, of history being recalled from eons when existence itself was young.
"Each one has their own unique nature and existence. Due to THE First Cause and the nature of THE Prima Indifferentia, they remained there as existence had nothing to move them."
His voice dropped to something more weighted.
"For any Primordial Architect, the Scale they were born in would be the Scale that they stay in forever."
He paused, letting the implications settle.
"For them, there was no Adversity. No change. Until...THE Living Paradox changed a few things."
There was no Adversity.
Noah thought about these words calmly as the weight of them pressed against his consciousness. The Primordial Architects had been born at their peaks.

They had never struggled to reach heights that were simply their birthright. They had never fought against limitations that they had been created without. They had never known the growth that came from overcoming, the elevation that came from transcending, the transformation that came from becoming something more than what you were.
They were static perfection.
They were completion without journey.
They were the concept of beings created in their final form!
And suddenly, a question crystallized in Noah’s mind with clarity that exceeded his previous understanding.
He looked at THE Creature with a straight face as he spoke.
"Is that why, from among them, there could be a defector? Someone that choose something different?"
The question was a heavy one.
If Primordial Architects were born at their Scales and stayed at their Scales forever, if they possessed no Adversity and therefore no growth, then defection wasn’t merely leaving a group.
It was rejecting the fundamental nature of what you were. It was choosing imperfection over perfection. It was embracing the struggle that your existence had been designed to never require.
Toward this question, THE Creature smiled.

It was a calm expression on his noble features, his extraordinary air of power unchanged by the weight of what had been asked. His multicolored flames burned steadily, revealing nothing, concealing everything. He didn’t answer, and he didn’t confirm, nor did he deny.
He simply smiled with the patience of someone who understood that some questions answered themselves given enough time.

His gaze turned in a different direction, as if he was seeing something unfathomably far away that required his attention. His massive Absolute Effigy began to rise, the multicolored flames expanding as he prepared to depart!
