chapters.title: Chapter 4955: Truly Live! IV
paragraphs: But before he left, he turned back to Noah with an expression that had shifted from enigmatic to sincere.
"Existence is vast and filled with terrors. A friend of ours loves to say this."
His voice held warmth that exceeded his usual detached nobility.
"Existence is also filled with unfathomable possibilities and wonders. Anaximander likes to say this."
Something like nostalgia flickered in those swirling multicolored eyes.

"If things were different. If existence was different... someone like Anaximander would have been much happier to be an explorer. Someone who looked to the stars, no authority within their existence, just curiosity and wonder that would take decades of his time, until he came to rest."
His flames dimmed slightly as he continued.

"Sometimes those existences with limited lifespans, who only live a matter of decades or a few hundred years, sometimes they live grander and more fulfilling lives than those of us who live for millions or billions of years or even eons."
The weight of these words pressed against Noah’s consciousness!
"Sometimes authority and power complicates. Sometimes you can live for eons and not be fulfilled. A long life is not necessarily a fulfilling life."
His multicolored eyes fixed on Noah with intensity that exceeded everything previous.
"So the most that I can tell you, as you go through the Adversity that you are going through, remember to actually live. To actually be alive."

"I played with the demarcation of life and death. Of Living Existences and Dead Existences. Of THE Veil between The Living and The Dead. And I found that at times, The Dead lived more than the living."
The words settled with weight that pressed against the fabric of existence itself.
"Live, Youngest. Live."
As he said this, the massive figure of THE Creature began to flicker and disappear.

Noah looked at this being calmly and took in all of his words. This was good advice, a counsel that most beings would spend eons trying to understand. The existential question of what it meant to truly live, to be alive rather than merely existing, to experience rather than merely endure, it was the kind of wisdom in itself.
But... it was already something that he was doing.

He wasn’t only obsessed with progression and achievement. He made sure to have multiple bodies moving within THE Infiniverse, to be farming, to be with his family, to be with hismanywomen. He was living.
But...
Maybe he could live even more.
He thought about everything as he replied to THE Creature.
"Good luck on all your Adversities. And give my greetings to Anaximander. Until next time."
HUUM!
The massive Absolute Effigy of THE Creature smiled. He nodded lightly.
"Until next time."
He paused.
"And oh, go easy on her."
With such words, THE Creature disappeared.

The surroundings flickered in and out of brilliance as Noah found himself back near that mountain in Alfheimr, the twilight of this Primordial Realm settling around his Absolute Effigy with familiarity.
But at this time, the massive manifestation of THE Creature was no longer there.
In that temple atop that grand mountain, THE Creature was no longer there.
As for what his last words meant...
Noah’s expression became cold as ice forming on still water.

He looked down at the mountain, his gaze piercing across many things to land on THE Living Emotive. She stood beside her bonded Undivided One, that great winged lion with its serpent mane, her pink Absolute Effigy burning with manic energy that matched her emotional nature.
The one THE Creature was referring to when he told him to go easy on her was this dumb bitch.

Because at this time, Noah could feel the silent weavings bound to invisible manic emotions that had flowed into the Undivided One beside Emotive undetected. He could perceive them with his elevated Geodesic awareness, could trace their paths with perception that curved along routes of minimal distance to find what was being hidden.
The same weavings were being sent toward him.
THE Living Emotive was actually trying to form another Bond, even though she had told THE Creature that she had utilized her last one on this Undivided One.
She had deceived the entity whose Bond she already possessed. She was attempting to claim Noah as well, to add him to her collection, to make him the fourth of THE Five that she had Bonded.
But of course, existence was filled with liars.
And THE Living Emotive was simply one of the worst ones.

She looked up toward Noah’s massive manifestation with expression that held none of the guilt her actions warranted. Her pink eyes sparkled with manic interest that bordered on obsession. Her lips curved into a smile that seemed designed to disarm, to charm, to manipulate.
She even waved toward him innocently.
As if she wasn’t already enacting a ridiculous and horrendous process right now.

She was a unique existence. She had bonded with three of THE Five and survived to tell the tale. She was successful enough to have THE Creature tell Noah to go easy on her. And she now tried to make Noah the fourth one she was bonded to, her invisible emotional weavings reaching toward him with persistence that exceeded shame.
Against such a being...
Noah’s massive Absolute Effigy raised its hand.

The motion was slow and deliberate, his golden manifestation shimmering in the skies of Alfheimr with light that painted the twilight in shades of blue and gold. His fingers spread wide, his palm turning to face the mountain below where THE Living Emotive stood with her innocent smile and her waving hand.
"Begone."
The word emerged with weight that exceeded mere sound.
And then his hand moved forward.

The golden manifestation of his palm swept through the air of Alfheimr with speed that exceeded what its slow beginning had suggested. It wasn’t a punch. It wasn’t a strike meant to obliterate. It was a backhand slap, the kind of casual dismissal that one might give to an annoying insect, the kind of contemptuous gesture that spoke of disdain exceeding anger!
His hand arrived before THE Living Emotive.

Her eyes widened with shock that exceeded anything her previous expression had contained. Her smile froze on her face as she realized what was happening, as she understood that her manipulations had been perceived, as she comprehended that her innocent act had fooled no one!
She hadn’t expected this at all.
The impact...was devastating!

chapters.title: Chapter 4956: Truly Live! V
paragraphs: BOOM!

The cheek of her Absolute Effigy distorted from the backhand slap, the pink flames that comprised her manifestation compressing and warping under force that exceeded anything she had prepared to receive.
The shape of her face bent inward where Noah’s golden hand made contact, her features twisting with impact!
And because her Absolute Effigy was connected to her physical body, her actual cheek deformed as well.
Her flesh compressed. Her bones cracked. Her existence registered damage that couldn’t be hidden behind manifestation.
Then she flew.

Her body flung backward like a spinning ragdoll, rotating end over end as the force of Noah’s backhand launched her away from where she had been standing. She spun through the air of Alfheimr with speed that exceeded what her Absolute classification should have permitted, her pink Effigy flickering and wavering as it struggled to maintain coherence.
The force of her being thrown was so much that she flew upward rather than backward.

She ascended toward the peak of the mountain, toward the temple where THE Creature used to reside, her spinning form leaving trails of pink light in her wake. And then she smashed into that ancient structure with impact that made the entire mountain tremble!
BOOM!

Stone shattered. Walls collapsed. The temple that had housed one of the most powerful beings in Observable Existence crumbled around the form of THE Living Emotive as she crashed through it without slowing.
When the dust settled, she lay in the ruins with expression that had lost all its previous confidence.
Her state was shocked and haggard.

Her pink Effigy flickered weakly around her battered form, the manic energy that had defined it now stuttering and uncertain. Her physical body was worse. Her cheek was swollen and purple where Noah’s slap had connected. Her lip was split. Blood ran from her mouth in streams that spoke of damage exceeding surface injury.
She opened her mouth to speak, perhaps to protest, perhaps to plead, perhaps to attempt manipulation one more time.
And all her teeth fell out.

They tumbled from her bleeding gums like offerings being rejected, like prayers being denied, like the symbols of her confidence being stripped away one by one. Her mouth was bloody and empty, her jaw aching with pain that her Absolute regeneration would eventually heal but that currently defined her existence.
She could barely rise up.

But she managed to turn her bloodshot eyes toward Noah, toward the massive golden Effigy that still loomed in the skies of Alfheimr with expression of absolute coldness. She was about to say something, about to attempt words through her ruined mouth, about to try one more manipulation despite everything that had just occurred.
Then she saw his extremely cold and domineering gaze.
She saw the complete lack of mercy in those golden eyes.
She saw what would happen if she pushed further.
She bit her lips with her bleeding gummy jaws, the pain of that action adding to the pain she already felt. And she said nothing.
Noah looked at her coldly.
This was him going easy on her.

The other option would have been to collapse her existence completely. To unmake everything she was with Geodesic Negations that would have found every aspect of her being and denied it. To crystallize her with Infinite definition until nothing remained but a statue of what she had been. To harvest her entirely and add her accumulated authority to his own foundations.
THE Creature had asked him to go easy on her.
So he had.

He did make sure to record this entire scene, to weave this display of existence so that it could be shown to others. Malphas, that old butler who had once been a servant of this woman, might want to see her humiliated. If that loyal existence told Noah that he still wanted to see her brought lower, or to be the one doing the humiliation himself, then Noah would simply come back and arrange it.
But for now, as a favor to THE Creature who already had a Bond with this wretched thing, he let her off easy!

His actions were heavy enough that even the Undivided One she had bonded with on the mountain didn’t dare to raise its eyes to look toward Noah. The great winged lion with its serpent mane pressed itself flat against the ground, its massive form trying to appear as small as possible, its entire demeanor screaming...
Bro, I’m not even here!
I’m just a small lion!

Noah’s eyes remained grand and imperious as he reflected on his conversation with THE Creature. The words about living, about being alive rather than merely existing, echoed through his consciousness with weight that exceeded their simple syllables. He would consider them. He would apply them. He would ensure that his path included experience as well as progression.
But first, he had work to do.

He turned his gaze from the ruined temple toward a distant area in the same Primordial Realm. There, THE Primordial Chaos resided with his isolated territory, his cautious nature having kept him separated from the events that were unfolding across Observable Existence. There was where Noah’s illusory manifestation had been conversing with him. There was where he needed to have another conversation.
About THE Primordial Mycelia.
About the possibility that Chaos himself might be compromised without knowing it.
About the warning that THE Mnemonic Leviathan had given regarding the Keys of Civilization.

But first, he had to make sure that his new Immensities of Infinities were spread out across as much of his existence as possible. Every capability needed to be elevated. Every weaving needed to be transformed. Every aspect of what he was needed to incorporate the Geodesic architecture that his Countable Infinity had unlocked!
For this, he closed his eyes and focused on his mental mindscape.

In its endless seas of blue and gold, RUINATION was already there. Her form burned with blue-gold light that matched his own, her hair extending into infinite data points, her eyes swirling with analysis that had been preparing for this moment since his epiphany had transformed his path.
She was ready to seamlessly define the changes he was implementing.
And so, the work continued!

chapters.title: Chapter 4957: The Spread of Infinities! I
paragraphs: Cultivation was hard.
If it were easy, there wouldn’t be so many old scheming monsters who did so much just to make convoluted plans, genocide of countless beings, and who knows what else just for their advancement.

Countless cultivators had spent eons just to take a single step forward. Countless more had spent those same eons and achieved nothing at all. The path of progression was littered with the corpses of those who had tried and failed, who had struggled and been found wanting, who had reached for heights beyond their grasp and been broken by the attempt.
Cultivation for Noah was also hard but... in a different way.
With his Infinity currently being Countable and Geodesic Weavings falling under his grasp, he had to do as much as he could to incorporate these ideas of Infinity into every aspect of his existence.
Without breaking himself.

Because this was what he was genuinely feeling could be possible as he played with Countable Infinities and Geodesic Weavings. The power was immense. The potential was heavy. But integrating it incorrectly could shatter everything he had built, could collapse the careful architecture of his Civilization into something that couldn’t sustain its own weight.
Geodesic Weavings were unique as even he had to go over them a few times to truly understand what he was playing with.
Simply, Geodesic was... the shortest path between two points.
Easy!
The shortest path!

If he wanted to go, let’s say, from one end of THE Prima Indifferentia to another end, one might think the shortest path is a straight line through the middle. But if the middle, if that straight line is swampy and filled with Undivided Ones and Primordial Architects, crossing it means it’s actually the slowest and most difficult path.
So the actual shortest path would involve going around the edges.
The feature of his Infinities, Geodesic Weavings... they extend infinitely while taking the shortest possible path through existence itself.

The examples he had carried out so far were how Embodiments could be blocked and Apophasis could be resisted, but Geodesic Weavings curved around obstacles, finding the natural line that connected his authority to his target with minimal distance and maximum efficiency.
That was the shortest path.
Now, he had begun to apply this understanding to many more things as his existence was buzzing with transformation. In his mindscape, RUINATION began to outline exactly what he was accomplishing!

Her blue-gold form brightened as streams of data flowed through her infinite hair, her eyes burning with analysis that had been processing his changes in real-time. Around her, constructs of pure light began forming, diagrams that would make the abstract tangible.
|Elevation of THE Civilizational Instinctus to Geodesic Classification.|
A massive construct appeared showing Noah’s Civilizational Instinctus as a pulsing core of awareness, with four distinct functions branching outward like limbs of a great tree.
|Your Civilizational Instinctus now operates through Countable Infinity and Geodesic principles. Each of its four functions has been transformed by the architecture of your Infinite Formless Depth.|
The four branches in the diagram began to glow sequentially as RUINATION prepared to explain each one.
|Primary Function Elevated: Geodesic Autonomous Response.|

The first branch illuminated, showing a representation of threats approaching Noah from multiple directions. In the old diagram, defensive responses traveled in straight lines to meet them. In the new diagram, the responses curved gracefully, finding paths that intercepted dangers before they could fully form.

|Previously, your Autonomous Existential Response reacted to threats before conscious processing. Now it reacts along paths that curve through existence to intercept dangers before they fully manifest. Your Civilization moves not merely with purpose transcending thought but with purpose following the natural geometry of reality itself.|
The diagram showed threats dissolving before they could reach their intended destinations, each one met by defensive expressions that had found the optimal route to interception.

|When threats approach, your response extends infinitely to meet them. The response arrives sequentially and endlessly, each reaction followed by another, creating continuous defensive expression that compounds rather than dissipates.|
The visual demonstrated this compounding effect, showing single threats being met by waves upon waves of defensive authority, each wave arriving along the same optimal curve.
|Enemies experience not a single counter but an Infinite sequence of counters arriving along natural lines of existence.|
|Secondary Function Elevated: Geodesic Manifestation Observation.|

The second branch illuminated, and the diagram shifted to show an enemy’s Civilizational Manifestation, its walls and pillars and foundations displayed in intricate detail. But overlaid upon that architecture were countless curved lines connecting every element to every other element.

|Previously, you perceived Civilizational Manifestations as architectural constructs surrounding entities. Now you perceive the natural pathways connecting every aspect of those constructs. You see not merely walls and pillars but the curves along which authority flows between them.|
RUINATION gestured, and the diagram rotated to show different angles of the same Manifestation, each angle revealing new pathways that hadn’t been visible before.

|When observing an enemy’s Civilization, you perceive infinite routes extending through their architecture. Each curve represents a potential avenue for your authority to travel. Each line reveals how their Civilization naturally directs force and where that direction creates openings.|
The diagram highlighted several openings that only became visible when the curved pathways were perceived, gaps in the architecture that straight-line observation would have missed entirely.
|You see their foundations as a map of possibilities rather than static structure.|
|Tertiary Function Elevated: Geodesic Structural Analysis.|

The third branch illuminated, and the diagram zoomed in on a single crack in the enemy’s architectural wall. But from that crack, curved lines extended outward, connecting to pillars, to foundations, to the very core of the Civilization being observed.

|Previously, you identified vulnerability points within observed Manifestations. Now you perceive the natural connections linking those vulnerabilities to each other. A single weakness is no longer isolated. You see how striking one weakness leads naturally toward striking others along paths of least resistance.|
The diagram demonstrated this principle, showing a single strike at the crack rippling outward along the curved connections, each ripple becoming a new strike at a new weakness.

|Your analysis reveals cascading vulnerability chains. When you identify a crack in an enemy’s wall, you simultaneously perceive the connection linking that crack to the pillar it supports, to the foundation beneath the pillar, to the core Civilization that foundation upholds.|
The cascade in the diagram accelerated, showing the entire enemy architecture collapsing in sequence as one weakness led to another led to another.
|One strike along these natural paths becomes infinite strikes arriving sequentially at every connected weakness.|

Each of its four functions has been transformed by the architecture of your Infinite Formless Depth.|
The four branches in the diagram began to glow sequentially as RUINATION prepared to explain each one.
|Primary Function Elevated: Geodesic Autonomous Response.|
The first branch illuminated, showing a representation of threats approaching Noah from multiple directions.
In the old diagram, defensive responses traveled in straight lines to meet them.
In the new diagram, the responses curved gracefully, finding paths that intercepted dangers before they could fully form.
|Previously, your Autonomous Existential Response reacted to threats before conscious processing.
Now it reacts along paths that curve through existence to intercept dangers before they fully manifest.
Your Civilization moves not merely with purpose transcending thought but with purpose following the natural geometry of reality itself.|
The diagram showed threats dissolving before they could reach their intended destinations, each one met by defensive expressions that had found the optimal route to interception.
|When threats approach, your response extends infinitely to meet them.
The response arrives sequentially and endlessly, each reaction followed by another, creating continuous defensive expression that compounds rather than dissipates.|
The visual demonstrated this compounding effect, showing single threats being met by waves upon waves of defensive authority, each wave arriving along the same optimal curve.
|Enemies experience not a single counter but an Infinite sequence of counters arriving along natural lines of existence.|
|Secondary Function Elevated: Geodesic Manifestation Observation.|
The second branch illuminated, and the diagram shifted to show an enemy’s Civilizational Manifestation, its walls and pillars and foundations displayed in intricate detail.
But overlaid upon that architecture were countless curved lines connecting every element to every other element.
|Previously, you perceived Civilizational Manifestations as architectural constructs surrounding entities.
Now you perceive the natural pathways connecting every aspect of those constructs.
You see not merely walls and pillars but the curves along which authority flows between them.|
RUINATION gestured, and the diagram rotated to show different angles of the same Manifestation, each angle revealing new pathways that hadn’t been visible before.
|When observing an enemy’s Civilization, you perceive infinite routes extending through their architecture.
Each curve represents a potential avenue for your authority to travel.
Each line reveals how their Civilization naturally directs force and where that direction creates openings.|
The diagram highlighted several openings that only became visible when the curved pathways were perceived, gaps in the architecture that straight-line observation would have missed entirely.
|You see their foundations as a map of possibilities rather than static structure.|
|Tertiary Function Elevated: Geodesic Structural Analysis.|
The third branch illuminated, and the diagram zoomed in on a single crack in the enemy’s architectural wall.
But from that crack, curved lines extended outward, connecting to pillars, to foundations, to the very core of the Civilization being observed.
|Previously, you identified vulnerability points within observed Manifestations.
Now you perceive the natural connections linking those vulnerabilities to each other.
A single weakness is no longer isolated.
You see how striking one weakness leads naturally toward striking others along paths of least resistance.|
The diagram demonstrated this principle, showing a single strike at the crack rippling outward along the curved connections, each ripple becoming a new strike at a new weakness.
|Your analysis reveals cascading vulnerability chains.

When you identify a crack in an enemy’s wall, you simultaneously perceive the connection linking that crack to the pillar it supports, to the foundation beneath the pillar, to the core Civilization that foundation upholds.|
The cascade in the diagram accelerated, showing the entire enemy architecture collapsing in sequence as one weakness led to another led to another.
|One strike along these natural paths becomes infinite strikes arriving sequentially at every connected weakness.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4958: The Spread of Infinities! II
paragraphs: |Quaternary Function Elevated: Geodesic Targeted Undifferentiation.|

The fourth branch illuminated, and the diagram showed an attack being launched at the identified crack. But instead of stopping at impact, the attack continued along the curved pathways, leaving undifferentiated potential in its wake.

|Previously, your attacks directed at weaknesses carried additional effectiveness through undifferentiation. Now those attacks extend infinitely along natural curves, undifferentiating everything they touch along their path. The attack follows the connection linking weakness to all related aspects of the enemy’s existence.|
The diagram showed pillars forgetting their shape, walls dissolving into formless potential, foundations losing their memory of what they had supported.

|A single strike of Targeted Undifferentiation begins at the identified weakness and curves endlessly through the enemy’s Civilization, undifferentiating each connected element in sequence. Pillars forget they were pillars. Walls forget they were walls. Foundations forget they were foundations.|
The entire enemy architecture in the diagram collapsed into undifferentiated proto-potential, unable to remember or reconstitute what it had been.
|The undifferentiation spreads along natural paths until no differentiated structure remains.|
A new construct formed beside the first, this one showing THE First Tongue in its elevated state.
|Elevation of THE First Tongue to Geodesic Expression.|
The diagram displayed words being written, but instead of remaining static on their surface, the words extended outward in curved lines that traveled through the fabric of existence itself.

|Your mastery of THE First Tongue now incorporates Countable Infinity at its foundation. Every word you speak extends infinitely. Every sentence curves along natural paths toward its intended effect. THE First Tongue has become a language of endless expression following the geometry of existence.|
RUINATION’s eyes burned brighter as she continued.

|When you compose Inscriptions, the letters do not merely form on the page. They extend infinitely in the direction of their meaning, traveling through reality along routes that connect concept to manifestation with minimal resistance.|
The diagram showed an Inscription being written, its letters blazing with blue-gold light that curved outward toward distant targets, finding them regardless of obstacles between.
|Your written authority travels not in straight lines but in natural curves that find their targets regardless of what stands in the way.|
|Elevation of THE 27 Seals of Absolute Tongue.|
Twenty-seven symbols manifested around the diagram, each one representing a Phoneme that Noah had mastered. Each symbol pulsed with light that extended outward in its own unique curve.

|Each of your 27 Phonemes now resonates with Countable Infinity. When spoken or written, each Seal extends infinitely along its own path, its sound and meaning curving through existence to affect all instances of what it represents.|
The diagram showed multiple Seals being invoked simultaneously. Their curved extensions didn’t travel in parallel but intersected and merged at natural points of convergence.
|The Seals no longer require conscious combination to produce compound effects. When multiple Seals are invoked, their paths naturally intersect and merge along curves of minimal distance.|
The intersection points in the diagram blazed with light that exceeded what any individual Seal could produce.

|A declaration using three Seals produces not merely the combination of three effects but the infinite intersection of three extensions, creating effects that exceed what deliberate combination could achieve.|
RUINATION’s form solidified as she delivered the final assessment.

|Your position as Native Speaker of THE First Tongue has been elevated. You speak words that extend endlessly along natural paths, affecting everything they curve toward in sequence that never terminates.|
Noah absorbed everything that RUINATION had displayed, his consciousness processing the diagrams and manifestations with comprehension

Every aspect of his existence buzzed with the integration of these principles. His Civilizational Instinctus pulsed with awareness that curved through reality rather than merely observing it. His mastery of THE First Tongue burned with potential that extended infinitely rather than terminating at impact!
It was a glorious thing as he felt it all...across his bodies.

The light of Countable Infinity rippled outward from Noah’s body in THE Interstices, passing through the boundaries of his divided existence, flowing across the vastness of THE Infiniverse until it settled upon his body standing in the Early Veiled Shore.
Here, everything felt different.
Noah felt his existence buzzing as more and more parts of him responded to the Countable Infinities and Geodesic Weavings.
The integration wasn’t simple.

There were complex parts of him where he had to figure out exactly how to weave in these Countable Infinities in a way that worked, how to mix Geodesic Weavings in a way that didn’t allow anything to break. He was trying to change many things about himself simultaneously, and each change affected every other change in ways that required careful calibration.
One wrong integration could shatter foundations he had spent eons building.
One misaligned weaving could collapse structures that his Civilization depended upon!
"Careful now," he murmured to himself, feeling the delicate balance of forces within his existence. "Break something here, and it echoes everywhere..."
A break of infinity would be catastrophic!
His eyes lit up as he found his Countable Infinities and Geodesic Weavings flowing smoothly in another particular area!
And to really allow it to flourish, this body in THE Infiniverse would make the breakthrough.
His body in the Early Veiled Shore!
The fields stretched before him in radiant splendor.

Noah stood at the edge of cultivation zones that he had prepared across cycles of dedicated investment. The soil glowed with blue-gold light that pulsed in sequential patterns. Each field contained different configurations of planted Infinities, each one an experiment in what Countable expression could produce when given form through agriculture.
He had been a Monarch. A conqueror. An architect of Civilizations.
Now he would be a farmer.
The results were beginning to emerge.
Beside him, THE Infiniverse stood in her human manifestation. Her form was beautiful, and her eyes held the depths of countless realms.
She smiled at the field.
These were her lands. This was her territory. And Noah was making them bloom with Infinities that elevated everything they touched.
Moments later, RUINATION’s illusory figure formed beside them both!
Her blue-gold form shimmered into existence with hair extending into infinite data points and eyes burning with analysis. She looked at the fields, then at Noah, then smiled.
|Master managed to integrate two major areas, one relating to your people, the other relating to farming. I’ll quantify the former first...The New Capability of Bestowal of Bounded Infinity.|

chapters.title: Chapter 4959: The Spread of Infinities! III
paragraphs: A construct of light formed above the fields, displaying Noah’s Depths as containers of endless sequential expression.

|Your Depths now exist at Countable Infinity. This grants you the authority to bestow fragments of your Infinite nature upon those who follow your Civilization. These fragments are designated asBounded Infinities.They contain genuine Infinite properties while existing within limitations that your unbounded Countable Infinity does not possess.|
The diagram showed fragments being separated from Noah’s Infinity, each fragment glowing with the same blue-gold light but contained within visible boundaries that his own Infinity lacked.

|Bounded Infinityoperates like an interval with endpoints that nevertheless contains endless values within. Your followers would receive Infinity, but Infinity with a ceiling defined by your authority. They can grow endlessly within their bounds while never exceeding limits.|
"So they get Infinity..." Noah said, watching the diagram with calculating eyes. "But my Infinity, my rules...my ceiling."
This would be nice for Amser Modred and others like him. Beings controlled under the banner of his infinity!
He nodded.
"Good."
|Classification: Seeded Infinity.|
The diagram shifted to show one of these fragments being planted within a follower’s Civilization, taking root like a seed in fertile soil.

|When you bestow Bounded Infinity upon a follower, you plant a Seed of Infinity within their Civilization. This Seed grows according to their efforts and cultivation, producing Infinite expressions that regenerate and compound within the boundaries you have set.|
The seed in the diagram sprouted, growing into structures that filled the follower’s foundations with endless potential.

|A follower bearing Seeded Infinity experiences regeneration that exceeds what finite Civilizations can produce. Their foundations recover from damage with speed that approaches endless. Their authority replenishes faster than it can be depleted under normal circumstances. Their growth occurs along trajectories that finite beings cannot match.|
RUINATION’s eyes flickered with additional data.

|However, Seeded Infinity cannot exceed its Bounded nature. Where your Countable Infinity extends endlessly in sequence, their Bounded Infinity loops back upon itself when it reaches its ceiling. Where your Infinity grows without limit, theirs grows until it reaches the boundary you established, then densifies within that boundary rather than expanding beyond it.|
|Hierarchy of Seeded Infinity.|
Three tiers manifested in the diagram, each one representing a different level of bestowal.
|You may establish three tiers of Seeded Infinity based on the boundaries you set.|
The first tier illuminated.

|First Tier: Cyclical Infinity. The smallest bestowal. Followers receive Infinity that repeats in cycles, regenerating endlessly but returning to its starting point with each completion. Their power grows through repetition rather than expansion. Suitable for those newly bound to your Civilization.|
The second tier illuminated.

|Second Tier: Partially Bounded Infinity. A greater bestowal. Followers receive Infinity with a starting point but no ending point within their bounded range. They can extend endlessly in one direction while remaining anchored to the foundation you provide. Suitable for trusted members of your Civilization.|
The third tier illuminated brightest of all.

|Third Tier: Bounded Countable Infinity. The greatest bestowal short of your own unbounded nature. Followers receive Infinity that operates identically to your Countable Infinity but exists within a container defined by your authority. Suitable for Absolutes beneath your banner, and those you trust most completely.|
He smiled a brillaint smile that held no cruelty. Just practicality.
Those in Yggdrheim would be granted the most trusted tier of Infinity, others would follow!
|Effects on Follower Civilizations.|
The diagram expanded to show followers at each tier using their bestowed Infinity in combat.

|Followers bearing Seeded Infinity gain access to limited Geodesic expressions. Their Embodiments and Apophasis begin curving toward targets along natural paths rather than traveling in straight lines of conventional authority.|
Three examples manifested side by side.
|Cyclical Infinity bearers produce Curving Embodiments that follow partial geodesic paths before dissipating.|
|Partially Bounded Infinity bearers produce Extending Embodiments that follow geodesic paths further before reaching their limits.|

|Bounded Countable Infinity bearers produce Near-Geodesic Declarations that function almost identically to your own Geodesic Weavings, lacking only the unbounded extension that your full Countable Infinity provides.|
RUINATION’s form brightened.

|All bearers of Seeded Infinity experience accelerated cultivation. Where finite Civilizations require eons to progress through Depths, Seeded Infinity compresses this timeline dramatically. The endless regeneration within their bounds allows for growth that finite foundations cannot sustain.|
|Connection to Your Authority.|
The diagram showed lines of connection flowing between Noah and every bearer of his Seeded Infinity, a network of authority that bound them all to his Civilization.

|All Seeded Infinity derives from your Countable Infinity. This creates permanent connection between your Civilization and those who bear your Seeds. Their growth contributes to your growth. Their harvest flows partially toward you. Their achievements elevate your foundations alongside their own.|
"They grow, I grow," Noah said. "They harvest, I harvest..."
|Should a bearer of Seeded Infinity fall in combat, the Bounded Infinity they carried returns to you in full. Nothing is lost. The Seed you planted simply comes home.|
|Bestowal Methodology.|
The diagram showed the process of investment, Infinite Everythings flowing from Noah into recipients at varying quantities.

|To bestow Seeded Infinity, you must directly invest your Infinite Everythings into the target’s Civilization. The tier of Seeded Infinity granted depends on the quantity invested and the capacity of the recipient to bear Infinite nature.|
Oh?
|Cyclical Infinity requires minimal investment and can be granted to many simultaneously.|
|Partially Bounded Infinity requires moderate investment and should be granted selectively.|
|Bounded Countable Infinity requires substantial investment and should be reserved for those whose elevation directly serves your path.|
RUINATION’s assessment concluded this section.

|Your current harvest production allows for widespread bestowal of Cyclical Infinity, selective bestowal of Partially Bounded Infinity, and rare bestowal of Bounded Countable Infinity. As your Depths advance toward Uncountable Infinity, your capacity to bestow will increase proportionally.|
The diagram faded as RUINATION turned her attention to the fields themselves, where things had begun to bloom!
He wanted to tell her to breathe, that she was going through too much information! But she simply charged ahead.
|That...was the first part. Granting Infinities to your followers. The second part...is your sometimes neglected path of a farmer.|
The fields before Noah pulsed with light that exceeded what they had held moments before. Something was emerging from the soil he had saturated with his authority.

|Your investment of Infinities into the soil of the Early Veiled Shore has begun producing results that exceed conventional sacred herb cultivation. When Countable Infinity saturates the earth, when Undifferentiated Temporal Infinity accelerates growth across compressed eons, the vegetation that emerges carries properties that finite farming could never produce.|
Noah watched as three distinct types of growth began rising from different sections of his cultivated fields.
|Three classifications of Infinite Sacred Herbs have begun taking root. Each requires different cultivation methodologies and produces different effects upon harvest.|
RUINATION’s voice held warmth that exceeded her usual analytical tone.
|Your dream... of becoming a farmer has evolved beyond mortal agriculture.You now cultivate Infinity itself.|
"Finally," Noah breathed. "...Finally!"
HUUM!
|First Classification: THE Bounded Lotus of Sequential Eternity.|
In the nearest field, something extraordinary emerged from the saturated soil!

chapters.title: Chapter 4960: The Spread of Infinities! IV
paragraphs: Noah watched as a lotus began to bloom with petals that unfolded in perfect sequence.

The first petal opened, revealing blue-gold light within. Before that petal finished settling, the second petal began opening. Then the third. Then the fourth.The progression continued endlessly, the lotus never finishing its bloom but simply continuing to produce.
It was beautiful.
Not beautiful like conquest was beautiful, or like power was beautiful. Beautiful like...watching something grow. Beautiful like patience rewarded.
Beautiful like the simplest truth in existence: plant something, tend it, and it flourishes.
Oh!

|This herb grows in spiraling patterns that mirror the sequential nature of Countable Infinity. Its petals unfold one after another in endless progression, each petal containing the seed for the next. The lotus never finishes blooming. It simply continues producing petals in sequence.|
Noah stepped forward and reached toward the lotus!

His fingers touched one of the completed petals. The warmth exceeded physical temperature. The weight exceeded the delicate appearance. Within it, he could sense Bounded Countable Infinity already formed and waiting.
A Seed ready to be planted in whoever consumed it.
He plucked the petal carefully.
The lotus didn’t diminish. It simply continued blooming, producing more petals to replace what he had taken, the sequence uninterrupted by his harvest.
"One petal," he said, examining it. "One follower elevated to Bounded Countable Infinity. Without spending my own reserves."
He looked at the field of lotuses. Dozens of them. Each one blooming endlessly.

|Effects Upon Consumption: A follower who consumes petals from THE Bounded Lotus of Sequential Eternity receives Bounded Countable Infinity directly integrated into their Civilization. The petals bypass the need for your direct investment, carrying pre-formed Seeds of Infinity that take root within the consumer’s foundations.|
|One lotus can produce enough petals to elevate dozens of followers to Bounded Countable Infinity without depleting your own reserves.|
|This herb transforms your capacity to bestow Seeded Infinity from individual investment to mass cultivation.Your followers can be elevated through agriculture rather than direct authority transfer.|
|Second Classification: THE Convergent Root of Density Absolute.|
Noah moved to the second field, where something very different was occurring!

Instead of growing upward, the plants here grew downward. He could sense roots extending deep into the soil, burrowing along paths that curved toward concentrations of Infinite authority he had buried during preparation.
The roots didn’t spread wide. They dove deep, following the shortest paths through the earth to find and compress every fragment of Infinity within their reach.

|This herb grows downward rather than upward, its roots extending into the soil along geodesic paths that curve toward concentrations of Infinite authority. Where it finds such concentrations, it wraps around them and draws them inward, compressing Infinity into density that exceeds its original configuration.|
Noah knelt and reached into the soil, his authority allowing him to perceive what was happening beneath the surface!

The roots had wrapped around units of Infinite Observable Harvest he had buried. They were squeezing those units, compressing them, forcing sequential expressions closer and closer together until gaps began filling.
|What enters the root as sequential Countable expressions emerges as something denser. Something approaching the spaces between sequences.|
One root had completed its compression!
Noah grasped it and pulled, feeling resistance that spoke of weight exceeding what the root’s size suggested. When it emerged from the soil, it glowed with density that made his eyes narrow.
This was... what he needed for his own advancement.
Advancing others was great and all, but he needed something for himself!
He held the root, feeling the concentrated Infinity within it pressing against his perception. Years of saturation, compressed into something he could consume in an instant.
"The lotus elevates my followers," he said slowly. "The root elevates me."
He looked between the two fields.

|Effects Upon Consumption: You experience saturation acceleration at whichever Depth you direct the root’s compressed authority toward. The root has already performed the work of filling gaps between your sequential Infinite expressions.Consuming it introduces pre-densified Infinity directly into your foundations, aiding your advancment towards your progression from Countable toward Uncountable Infinity.|
|Each root consumed represents compressed eons of saturation occurring instantaneously. Your advancement toward Uncountable Infinity becomes a matter of cultivation rather than endless waiting.|
First, it was a Lotus, and second, it was a root!
And the third and final wonder to bloom in his farming fields of infinity?
|Third Classification: THE Divergent Bloom of Infinite Variation.|
Noah moved to the third field, where chaos reigned in beautiful form!
Plants grew in every direction simultaneously, their branches splitting endlessly as they extended toward the horizon.

No two branches followed the same path. Flowers bloomed at random points along each branch, and no two flowers held identical colors or shapes. Some were blue. Some were gold. Some were colors that shouldn’t have existed.
Each one unique.
Each one different.
Each one a possibility he hadn’t conceived.

|This herb grows outward in all directions simultaneously, its branches splitting endlessly as they extend toward the horizon. No two branches follow the same path. It was crimson and gold, its petals arranged in spirals that seemed to twist in directions his perception couldn’t quite follow. When he plucked it, he felt something shift in his awareness.
A glimpse of possibility that his current state couldn’t normally access.
"Interesting," he murmured, examining the flower.
He plucked another flower, this one blue and silver!
Its properties were different entirely. This one... offered a temporary glimpse of what Uncountable Infinity would feel like.
A preview of the Boundary he was working toward.
"Even more interesting."

|Effects Upon Consumption: Each flower provides a different effect based on the variation it embodies. Some flowers enhance specific Geodesic Weavings. Some flowers reveal weaknesses in enemies that your current perception cannot detect. Some flowers temporarily elevate a single Depth toward sensations of Uncountable Infinity, granting glimpses of what full advancement would feel like.|
RUINATION’s voice held something approaching awe.

|Most critically, certain rare flowers that emerge from extreme divergent branches contain properties you cannot predict. These flowers may provide breakthroughs in understanding that accelerate your path. They represent possibilities that your sequential Countable nature cannot generate on its own but that divergent cultivation can access.|
|It is chaos and randomness harnessed through Infinite cultivation, producing boons that deliberate planning cannot achieve.|
Noah looked at the field of divergent blooms, each flower a gamble, each harvest a surprise.
He smiled.
"The lotus for followers. The root for advancement. The bloom for surprises."
He turned to look at all three fields together.
|Integrated Cultivation Methodology.|
RUINATION’s final construct displayed all three fields working in harmony, their combined production flowing toward Noah’s Civilization.
|The three classifications ofInfinite Sacred Herbswork in harmony when cultivated together.|
|THE Bounded Lotus provides elevation for your followers, creating armies bearing Seeded Infinity without depleting your personal reserves.|
|THE Convergent Root provides density for your own advancement, compressing harvest into saturation that advances you toward Uncountable Infinity.|

|THE Divergent Bloom provides variation that neither you nor your followers can generate through sequential cultivation alone, offering breakthroughs and surprises that accelerate paths in unexpected directions.|
Her recommendation came with weight.

|Establish dedicated cultivation zones for each classification within the Early Veiled Shore. Maintain continuous investment through THE Infinite Observable Harvest. Apply Undifferentiated Temporal Infinity to compress growth cycles. Harvest regularly and consume strategically based on your current priorities.|
RUINATION’s form solidified as she delivered the final assessment, her eyes meeting Noah’s.

|Your role as THE Genesis Monarch now includes dominion over Infinite agriculture. What you plant determines what your Civilization becomes. What you harvest determines how quickly you and your followers advance toward heights that finite existence cannot reach.|
Noah stood among his fields with lotus petals in one hand and convergent roots in the other, with divergent flowers blooming in every direction around him.
He had always dreamed of becoming a farmer, and THE Creature had reminded him to live! To truly live!
"All those beings out there fighting and scheming and killing for scraps of power..."he said aloud, looking at his fields with satisfaction that exceeded anything conquest had given him.
While others were out there killing for power, he could simply grow it here!
He...did not necessarily need to find Undivided Ones or Formless Terrors or Primordial Architects to kill.
Only if he needed big jumps of Harvests as he was still receiving a steady stream!
All he truly needed was time to grow.
He laughed.
THE Infiniverse smiled beside him.
RUINATION’s illusory form flickered with brilliance.
And the harvest...had only just begun!

chapters.title: Chapter 4961: The Spread of Infinities! V
paragraphs: The light of inherited Infinity flickered across dozens of struggling forms, blue-gold scaffolding holding together existences that would otherwise dissolve into the endless undifferentiation of THE Yggdrheim.
Noah watched them all.

His son Henry stood at the center of the gathered beings, his Surface Depth burning brighter than it had before his arrival here. The inherited Infinity that had awakened within him fought constantly against the realm’s assault, each moment a battle between definition and dissolution that would continue for as long as he remained in this space.
Around Henry, the others struggled with varying degrees of success.

Barbatos maintained her form through sheer fury, her Necromancy finding no anchor in undifferentiation but her will refusing to accept dissolution. Adelaide’s existence flickered like a candle in wind, her features blurring and reforming as she fought to remember what she looked like!

Titano roared with confusion and pain, his massive form shrinking and expanding as undifferentiation pressed against him from every direction. The simple-minded Titan did not understand what was happening, only that it hurt, only that his existence was being challenged in ways that no enemy had ever challenged it before.

Sigrid, THE Living Order, frowned with concentration that bordered on desperation. Order and undifferentiation were fundamentally opposed, and every moment she spent in THE Yggdrheim felt like poison seeping into her foundations.

Khor’s Hunger bloomed in response to threat, her diminutive form blazing with authority that exceeded her size. She consumed the undifferentiation that pressed against her, turning dissolution into fuel for her own existence.
THE First Farmer stood beside her, his Effort burning brightly!

THE Emperor Penguin waddled in place with dignity that refused to acknowledge how close to collapse he actually was. This wingless, talentless bird maintained his noble bearing even as his edges dissolved and reformed in cycles that would eventually exhaust his capacity to regenerate.
Even Little Bobby, this cockroach, was here facing this Adversity!

The Land Lifeforms clustered together. Heidrun bleated with indignation. Malphas attempted composure that cracked with every wave of undifferentiation. Yoshinami’s many legs scrambled for purchase on reality that kept shifting beneath them.
An Arch Lich cackled even as he dissolved, finding humor in his own potential unmake that only the truly mad could appreciate.
They were all struggling.
They were all suffering.
And Noah had been watching long enough!

"You have all done well to survive this long,"he said, his voice pressing against THE Yggdrheim itself with authority that made the realm’s undifferentiation pause in its assault. "But surviving is not enough. You need to thrive."
He raised his hand.

In his palm, lotus petals materialized with light that exceeded anything the scaffolding had provided. Blue-gold radiance blazed from petals that had been harvested from THE Bounded Lotus of Sequential Eternity, each one containing pre-formed Seeds of Infinity that would transform whoever consumed them.
The petals were beautiful.

They spiraled with patterns that mirrored the sequential nature of Countable Infinity, each curve leading to the next in progression that could be observed and tracked even as it extended toward endlessness. The light they emanated pushed back against THE Yggdrheim’s undifferentiation with force that made the realm itself seem to recoil.

"What I hold in my hand is something I have cultivated,"Noah said, "THE Bounded Lotus of Sequential Eternity. Each petal contains Bounded Countable Infinity. When you consume them, you will no longer be finite beings struggling against dissolution."
He paused.
"You will be... Infinite."
BOOM!
The gathered beings stared at the petals with expressions that ranged from desperate hope to confused uncertainty. They did not fully understand what Bounded Countable Infinity meant.
They only knew that Noah was offering something, and that something might end the suffering they had been enduring since their arrival.
Noah scattered the petals!

They flew outward from his palm like seeds carried by wind that should not have existed in THE Yggdrheim. Each petal found its target with precision. One petal landed before Henry. Another before Barbatos. Another before Adelaide. Another before Athena.

Petals fell before Titano, before Sigrid, before Khor, before THE First Farmer. They landed before THE Emperor Penguin, before the Land Lifeforms, before Riya, before Bob, before the cackling Arch Lich!
Every being that Noah had brought to this realm received a petal that glowed with blue-gold light containing transformation beyond anything they had experienced.
"Consume them," Noah commanded. "And become something more."
Henry was the first to act.

His hand, still flickering between stability and dissolution, reached for the petal that had landed before him. His fingers closed around it with grip that exceeded what his current state should have allowed. And then he brought it to his lips and consumed it.
The effect was immediate!
HUUM!

Blue-gold light exploded from within Henry’s existence as the Bounded Countable Infinity contained in the petal took root in his foundations. The Seed of Infinity that had been pre-formed within the petal found fertile soil in his Civilization, sprouting with speed that exceeded natural growth, spreading through his existence with patterns that mirrored his father’s own Infinite nature.
His dissolving edges solidified entirely!
Nepotism began to bloom at its finest!
Oh!

The flickering that had characterized his form since arrival ceased as Bounded Countable Infinity established itself throughout his being. His features became distinct and stable in ways that the scaffolding alone had never achieved. His blue-gold hair blazed with color that exceeded what it had held even before his arrival in THE Yggdrheim.
He was no longer a finite being struggling against undifferentiation.
He was Infinite.
Bounded, yes. Limited by ceilings that his father’s authority had established. But Infinite nonetheless, possessing regeneration and growth that finite Civilizations could never match.
Prompts bloomed in Noah’s awareness as RUINATION documented the transformation occurring in his son.
|Transformation Detected: Henry Osmont|
|Previous Classification: Finite Surface Depth cultivator with inherited Infinite potential.|
|Current Classification: Bounded Countable Infinity bearer at Surface Depth.|

|Transformation Details: THE Bounded Lotus of Sequential Eternity has integrated Seeded Infinity into subject’s foundations. Subject now possesses genuine Infinite properties within boundaries established by your authority. Regeneration approaches endless. Foundation recovery exceeds finite parameters. Growth trajectory has been fundamentally altered.|

|Subject’s Assertions will now produce Curving expressions that follow partial geodesic paths. Subject’s cultivation timeline has been compressed dramatically. Subject can now survive THE Yggdrheim’s undifferentiation through Infinite regeneration.|

|Assessment: Henry Osmont has crossed the threshold from finite to Infinite. His Bounded Countable Infinity will grow according to his efforts within the boundaries you have established. He remains beneath your unbounded nature but now possesses genuine claim to Infinity.|
Around Henry, the others began consuming their petals!

chapters.title: Chapter 4962: The One Percent I
paragraphs: Barbatos brought the petal to her lips. Blue-gold light exploded from within her as Bounded Countable Infinity took root, her Necromancy finding anchor in Infinite regeneration that undifferentiation could not overcome.
Adelaide consumed her petal with grace that belied her desperation.

Titano consumed his petal with the simple trust of someone who did not question what his Brother offered. Blue-gold light transformed his massive form as Bounded Countable Infinity spread through a Titan’s foundations. His roars of confusion became roars of triumph as his existence stabilized entirely.
"Haha, I knew Brother would take care of me!"
Sigrid, Khor, and all others did the same.
The Arch Lich consumed his petal while still cackling, his madness now Infinitely regenerating alongside his existence.
Many prompts came and went that Noah passed through.
|Mass Transformation Complete|
|All subjects have successfully integrated Bounded Countable Infinity through consumption of petals from THE Bounded Lotus of Sequential Eternity.|

|Current Status: All subjects now possess genuine Infinite properties within boundaries established by your authority. Their regeneration approaches endless. Their foundation exceeds finite parameters. Their growth trajectories have been fundamentally altered.|

|THE Yggdrheim’s undifferentiation can no longer threaten dissolution. Subjects will still experience pressure from the realm, but that pressure will serve as cultivation stimulus rather than existential threat.|
Noah watched as his gathered people stabilized entirely.

They were no longer struggling against dissolution. They were no longer fighting moment to moment for survival. They were no longer drowning in undifferentiation that exceeded their capacity to resist.
They were breathing.

The terrifying weavings of undifferentiation still pressed against them from every direction. THE Yggdrheim had not become less hostile. The realm still sought to return all differentiated things to formless potential. But now, with Bounded Countable Infinity burning in their foundations, they could somewhat handle it.
They still had Adversity!
But they could do it.
Noah’s voice carried across THE Yggdrheim with weight that pressed against every Infinite being present.
"This is the last time I aid you in your Adversity."
His words settled with implications that exceeded their simple statement.
"With Infinities in your hands, what you can do is endless. Your potential approaches endless."
He paused, letting them absorb this truth.
"But potential is meaningless without actualization. You are Infinite now, but you are Infinite at Surface Depth, or Intermediate Depth, or Fundamental Depth. You are not Absolute."
His eyes swept across the gathered beings with intensity that exceeded anything he had displayed during their suffering.
"And anything less than Absolute will likely get you one-shotted in the vastness of existence."
The words were harsh.
They were true!

"Today, a Primordial Architect named Horus announced himself across Existence. There are others like him. There are Formless Terrors and Undivided Ones waking across THE Prima Indifferentia. There are threats emerging that your current Depths cannot comprehend, let alone survive."
He folded his hands behind his back.

"So you... will roam THE Yggdrheim. You will find the resources that this realm contains. You will use the pressure of undifferentiation as cultivation stimulus. And you will become Absolute as quickly as possible."
His voice hardened.
"I will not hold your hands. I will not protect you from threats that your Infinite regeneration can handle. I will not coddle you with safety that prevents growth."
"You have Infinity now. Use it. Become Absolute."
He paused.
"Survive. Persevere. Become something that existence cannot ignore."
Noah finished setting up the adversity for his people as his other bodies continued to move.
He had already done a lot. THE Yggdrheim now held beings transforming from finite to Infinite. THE Infiniverse held fields of sacred herbs producing elevation and density and variation.
His other body in THE Interstices continued writing new Inscriptions with Geodesic Weavings that would define his Civilization’s future while he talked with Amser Modred.
But... he wanted to see if it was possible to bring all of these changes to THE Numerical Sovereignty.

As unrealistic as it was, could the weavings of mathematics he had begun playing with be granted similar musings of Infinities? Of Geodesic Weavings? Could multiplication and exponentiation curve along paths of minimal distance? Could division extend infinitely toward their targets?
As he embarked on this idea, his existence became focused.
Well, part of his consciousness became focused.
His Absolute Body with the Infinite Undifferentiated Fate in Alfheimr had taken a step to disappear from the mountain where Emotive lay with all her teeth knocked out.
Infinities had struck her, but she would regenerate eventually. She would recover her smile and her manipulations and her endless attempts to bond with beings far beyond her station.
But she would remember this lesson for a long, long time.
Well, if she was among those who will survive this coming week and month without being collapsed.

Noah’s body shimmered across the distance of Alfheimr, his Absolute Vision of Existence allowing him to cross vast stretches instantaneously. He proceeded to meld with his illusory consciousness that had been near THE Primordial Chaos this whole time, the projection becoming real, substance replacing shadow.
Beside him, Ul’moreth, THE Big Stepper, had continued to wait with patience that exceeded his usual demeanor.
The hairy Absolute stood at attention with seriousness.
<THE Primordial Chaos, Abaddon. The Age Between Ages, The First Age of Infinity.>
Abaddon stared at the intriguing figure of THE Youngest as his illusory body became real.
A genuine existence now stood beside his follower, the hairy Absolute, Ul’moreth.

Where moments before there had been projection and presence, there was now flesh and blood and Civilization burning with golden Infinite Undifferentiated Fate that exceeded what projections could display.
The region around them had transformed during Abaddon’s presence here.

Rivers of obsidian chaos flowed through what had once been standard territory of Alfheimr, dark currents that carried entropy and possibility in equal measure. The signature weavings of this Primordial Realm, its twilight and ancient mountains and forests that had stood since THE First Cause, all of it had become backdrop to something older.
Something more fundamental.
For Abaddon, this was normal.

As THE Primordial Chaos, everywhere that he remained long enough became a place that would gradually change to be surrounded by Chaos and entropy. The obsidian rivers were his signature. The churning darkness was his presence made manifest. The sense that anything could happen, that probability itself bent toward uncertainty in his vicinity, that was simply what it meant to stand near a being who embodied the raw potential from which all differentiation had originally emerged.
After all, that was the true nature of things!
Order was temporary. Structure was borrowed time. Everything eventually returned to the chaos from which it came.
At this time, Abaddon watched as THE Youngest patted his hairy follower with casual familiarity.
"Visit my little place called THE Yggdrheim for a moment. I should be okay."
The words were simple. The dismissal was confident.

Ul’moreth nodded with a serious gaze that held concern despite the directive. His eyes flickered between THE Youngest and Abaddon with calculation. But in the end, he was a follower, and his Monarch had given instruction.
He disappeared.
The only ones left behind were Abaddon and THE Youngest.

chapters.title: Chapter 4963: The One Percent II
paragraphs: Abaddon had been thinking about doing many things. He had sensed all the events that had just occurred across Observable Existence.
But instead of acting on any of these observations, he asked a different question.
"Your weavings just intertwined with THE Creature?"
His voice carried the weight of rivers that flowed through realities yet unformed.
"He is an interesting guy, isn’t he?"
Abaddon asked such a question while he thought of THE Creature.

Whenever he did look at THE Youngest and THE Creature, he couldn’t help but think of how alike they were. Not in power, though THE Youngest was growing at rates that defied conventional understanding.
Not in methodology, though both seemed to approach existence with calculation that exceeded many things.
It was something in their eyes.
The first time Abaddon had met THE Creature was in THE Prima Indifferentia.

At that time, THE Creature looked like something that had just undergone a rebirth into another form. His manifestation had been unstable, flickering between configurations as if he hadn’t yet decided what he wanted to be. Abaddon considered him younger at that moment, as his own Depth had been higher than THE Creature’s at that time. At that time.
But it seemed to be on a technicality.
Anyways, at that time, the eyes of THE Creature reminded Abaddon of something he couldn’t quite identify.
Now he knew.
They reminded him of the eyes of THE Youngest.
That same burning certainty. That same sense that existence itself was merely raw material waiting to be shaped according to will.
It was a gaze of pride and arrogance that was dangerous.
At this time, THE Youngest smiled and nodded at Abaddon’s question.
"Powerful beyond measure. A very interesting guy."
His golden eyes held appreciation.
"But I was curious about you a bit more."
Abaddon’s obsidian chaos swirled with interest at this statement. THE Youngest had been keeping him back from attacking the infection spreading across existence for some time now.
"And I wanted to ask you about probabilities."
Probabilities?
Hah!

Chaos was filled with probabilities and possibilities! Every moment contained infinite potential outcomes. Every action spawned countless branches of what-could-be. Every decision collapsed wave functions of maybe into singular expressions of is.

There was so much to be done right now. THE Entity spread further with every passing moment. THE Primordial Mycelia’s infection claimed more beings with every breath. And yet THE Youngest wanted to discuss probabilities?
But THE Youngest spoke still.

His form shimmered with blue-gold flames as Infinite Undifferentiated Fate manifested visibly around his existence. The golden light pressed against Abaddon’s obsidian chaos without conflict, two fundamental forces acknowledging each other without competing.
"Let’s use an Undivided One as an example."
His voice held the weight of something being constructed.

"Let’s say there was something called Bazuman. An Undivided One of tremendous power who had existed since before THE Infinite Unfurling. A being of undifferentiation and consumption who believed himself invincible because nothing had ever truly threatened his existence."
Abaddon listened with attention that exceeded casual interest. THE Youngest was building toward something.

"Now let’s say that despite all of Bazuman’s power, despite all of his accumulated authority and consumed existences and invincible reputation, there existed a one percent probability that collapse was coming for him."
THE Youngest paused.
"One percent. Ninety-nine roads lead to Bazuman’s continued dominance. But one road, just one, leads to his complete and utter annihilation."
His golden eyes fixed on Abaddon with intensity that exceeded the hypothetical nature of the question.

"Would Bazuman take this one percent seriously even though the chance of it happening was so low? Would he ignore that single percentage point because ninety-nine others favored his survival? Or would he do anything, absolutely anything, to make sure that one percent didn’t even exist?"
Abaddon raised his brows and blinked.
What was THE Youngest up to?
His reply didn’t take long. This was, after all, a question that touched upon the very nature of what he represented.
"A percent chance is still a percent chance."
His voice deepened with authority that predated THE Infinite Unfurling.

"It is as if there are one hundred roads. Ninety-nine roads will lead to the same result. But that one road is still there. It exists. It waits. It holds potential that the other ninety-nine cannot negate through mere numerical superiority."
The rivers of obsidian chaos around them churned with emphasis as Abaddon continued.

"You see, Youngest, this is what many beings fail to understand about probability and chaos. They look at percentages and see safety in large numbers. They look at one percent and see something so small that it can be dismissed. They calculate their odds and feel comfort in ninety-nine percent certainty."
He shook his head slowly.
"But certainty is illusion. And probability is not prediction. It is description of possibility space, nothing more."
The obsidian rivers began flowing in patterns that demonstrated what he was explaining.

"Everything that can happen will happen given sufficient time and iteration. Every possible outcome exists within the probability space of every moment. The one percent is not less real than the ninety-nine percent. It is merely less frequent in a single sampling."
His eyes fixed on THE Youngest with intensity that matched what he had received.

"But collapse is not a single sampling. Collapse is permanent. If Bazuman faces one hundred threats across his existence, and each threat carries one percent chance of his annihilation, then across those hundred encounters, the cumulative probability of collapse approaches certainty rather than remaining negligible."
The patterns in the obsidian rivers became more complex.

"Furthermore, entropy favors the unlikely. Chaos tends toward maximum disorder. The state space of existence is not static. It evolves, it shifts, it transforms in ways that can take that one percent and make it ten percent, or fifty percent, or absolute certainty without warning."
Abaddon’s presence seemed to expand as he delivered the core of his philosophy.

"This is what chaos teaches those who truly understand it. The improbable is not impossible. The unlikely is not avoidable. And the one percent that seems negligible today may be the guaranteed outcome tomorrow because you chose to ignore it rather than address it."
He paused, letting his words settle like sediment in the obsidian rivers.

"I have watched civilizations fall because they calculated their survival at ninety-nine percent and dismissed the remaining percentage as acceptable risk. I have witnessed Absolutes collapse because they believed their foundations too strong to be threatened by improbable outcomes. I have seen beings older than THE Infinite Unfurling unmade because they failed to account for the one road that led somewhere other than their continued existence."
His conclusion came with weight that pressed against the very fabric of Alfheimr.

"So yes. Regardless of how low the percentage is, it has to be taken care of. It has to be addressed. It has to be eliminated if elimination is possible. Because if you leave that one percent existing, if you allow it to remain within your probability space, then entropy will find it. Chaos will favor it. And what seemed impossible will become inevitable."
"The one percent must be erased, or it may be guaranteed to happen."
